records.descriptionZh: 收集几辆Toyota的“86”前置后驱跑车。
records.requirementsEn: Collect: Toyota Corolla Levin 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86) '83, TOYOTA 86 GT '15, Toyota GR86 RZ '21
records.requirementsZh: 收集：Toyota Corolla Levin 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86) '83、TOYOTA 86 GT '15、Toyota GR86 RZ '21
records.storyEn:
The Toyota 86 (Hachi-Roku) is part of three generations
of the company's signature sports car.

It all began in 1983 with...

...the historic original models...

...the AE86 Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno.

While the bae Corolla and Sprinter were designed
as space-efficient FF vehicles...

...a sporty coupe version of the Levin
and Trueno...

...was developed with a FR drivetrain, a first
since the 1972 first-gen Levin (TE27).

Inheriting the rich history of the
AE86 Levin and Trueno...

...was the Toyota 86, which went on sale in 2012.

This lineae continued with its successor, the GR86.

The GR86 was a lightweight and agile car.

Thanks to its FR layout, it handled extremely
well...

...and welcomed enhancements through
aftermarket tuning.
records.storyZh:
丰田86是已经传承到第三代的
一款前置后驱跑车系列车型，

也是一辆绝赞的收藏品。

其历史“原型”来自……

1983 AE86卡罗拉Levin和Sprinter Trueno。

在后来，卡罗拉和Spinter的基础款被重新开发，
为了更高的空间利用率而改为了前置前驱车……

而这台接过Levin和Trueno衣钵的车型则
演变成了一辆双门跑车……

并采用丰田久经考验的前置后驱传动系统
——该系统最初用于1972年的第一代Levin（TE27）。

继承AE86 Levin和Trueno的前置后驱跑车历史的是……

丰田86，发售于2012年。

在它之后的继承者则是GR86，
同样保留了前辈的所有特性。

这是一款轻量级、操控性良好的车。

归功于前置后驱组合，极其容易上手……

而且无论在赛车运动还是改装方面
都具有无限的潜能。
!

records.descriptionEn: Collect some of Honda's prized Type R cars.}
records.descriptionZh: 收集几辆Honda的获奖Type-R车型。
records.requirementsEn: Collect: Honda NSX Type R '92, Honda Civic Type R (EK) '98, Honda Integra Type R (DC2) '98
records.requirementsZh: 收集：Honda NSX Type R '92、Honda Civic Type R (EK) '98、Honda Integra Type R (DC2) '98
records.storyEn:
These three Type Rs can well be considered Honda’s masterpieces.

It is an impressive collection indeed.

The "Type R" label is given to select models
in Honda’s lineup.

It signifies supreme performance and craftmanship.

The three cars in this collectin...

...are famous for giving birth to the Type R.
They are the best of the best.

Take the 1992 NSX-R, the first Type R in
Honda's history.

It was built to deliver superior handling...

...and may be considered as the progenitor of
the series.

Next, Honda had its eye on applying the NSX-R’s
prowess to its FF sports cars.

Leding the way were the 1995 DC2 Integra
Type R...

...and the first Honda Civic Type R, the EK9.

In the years that followed, only the best sports models
were given the Type R badge.

Actually, one could say that the Type R
goes back even further.

Back in the Formula 1 days of the 1960s...

....Honda was the first Japanese automaker
to compete in the series.

I entered the F1 in 1964, and it achieved
its first victory a year later.

At the time, Honda’s F1 machine sported
a white body and red emblem.

This has been carried over to the distinctive white-
and-red combination of the Type R series.

Therefore, the Type R badge is a declaration of
the company's F1 racing spirit.

Regardless of the model name, engine or drivetrain...

...the Type R badge has been handed down from car to car
to ensure the evolution of the sports car.
records.storyZh:
这三款Type R都属于本田的伟大杰作，

可以称得上是无价的收藏品。

一贯以来，“Type R”这个标签只授予本田旗下的精选车型。

它代表了极致的工匠技艺。

这次收藏中的三款车举世闻名……

代表了Type R的诞生。它们是王牌中的王牌。

先从1992 NSX-R说起吧，它是第一个以Type R之名出售的车型。

它是为追求极致的操作性而生……

也可以看作是这个系列的“鼻祖”——一辆真正的传奇。

在第一台Type R之后，本田着眼于将NSX-R的操控性
运用在前置前驱跑车上。

当先开道的便是1995 DC2形格Type R……

紧随其后的是本田思域Type R的首款车型，EK9。

在此后的岁月中，只有最顶尖的跑车车型
能被授予Type R的荣耀徽记。

从严格意义上来说，Type R的起源甚至可以追溯到……

20世纪60年代的F1比赛。

要知道，本田是第一个试水F1比赛*日本汽车制造商。

它于1964年首次参赛，并于次年第一次尝到了冠军的滋味。

在当时，本田的F1赛车采用了白色为底、红色纹样的涂装。

这一配色也被Type R继承，形成了系列独有的红白相间涂装。

Type R的徽记就是F1竞速精神的宣言。

不管车型、引擎或传动系统如何变化……

Type R的徽记将从一辆车传递到另一辆车上，
确保跑车的精神在演化中长存。

records.descriptionZh: 收集几辆Mazda的特殊转子引擎车型。
records.requirementsEn: Collect: Mazda RX-7 GT-X (FC) '90, Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02, Mazda RX-8 Spirit R '12
records.requirementsZh: 收集：Mazda RX-7 GT-X (FC) '90、Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02、Mazda RX-8 Spirit R '12
records.storyEn:
The Mazda RX-7 and RX-8 are rotary-engine sports cars.

They make a splendid collection indeed.

You know, the story behind Mazda’s rotary engines
is actually quite fascinating.

Rotary engines are in fact "Wankel engines" which were
developed by the Geran automaker NSU in the 1950s.

The man who came up with the concept was Felix Wankel,
hence the engine’s name.

Rotary engines employ a design that is very
different from piston engines.

They use a revolving rotor to transmit
motive force to the wheels.

They are able to generate a great deal of power
with relatively few parts.

Wankel engines were once said to be the ideal engine.

In 1961, Mazda (then called Toyo Kogyo) signed
a technical-cooperation deal with NSU...

...gaining the rights to the Wankel,
and set to work to further develop it.

However, the initial engine that NSU provided
has many problems, presenting many challenges.

Nevertheles, Mazda spent the next six years
working to overcome them.

In 1967, it unveiled the world’s first dual-rotor
rotary-engine road car...

...the Cosmo Sport.

Looking to test the reliability of its new engine...

...Mazda entered the 84-hour Marathon de la Route
at the legendary Nürburgring in Germany in 1968.

The company finished fourth overall.

Years later, at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, Mazda’s
rotary-engine-powered 787B...

...became the first Japanese car to win the competition.

Mazda is a company with more than 100 years of history...

And the RX-7 and RX-8 certainly made their mark.

We hope that the company's next generation of sports cars will
 ontinue to play a leading role in the history of rotary engines.
|
records.storyZh:
马自达RX-7和RX-8都是转子引擎跑车。

它们同样都是令人心驰神往的收藏。

关于马自达的转子引擎，有一段令人着迷的历史。

它的起源是“汪克尔引擎”，
由德国汽车制造商NSU在50年代制造。

这台性能猛兽的设计者是菲力斯·汪克尔，
该引擎也因此得名。

转子引擎采用的设计与常规引擎截然不同。

顾名思义，引擎采用旋转的转子将驱动力传递到车轮。

转子发动机只用相对较少的部件就能输出澎湃的动力……

也因此，它们一^被称为最理想的引擎。

1961年，马自达（当时名为“东洋工业”）与NSU签署了
一项技术合作协议……

并致力于开发属于自己的转子引擎。

然而，NSU最初开发的引擎并不够完善，留下了许多技术难题。

尽管如此，马自达还是用六年时间克服了所有挑战。

随>，马自达在1967年发布了世界上首辆
配备双转子引擎的街车……

Cosmo Sport。

为了验证引擎的可靠性……

马自达于1968年将它带到了传奇的纽博格林赛道，
参加了84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛……

并以总成绩第4名完赛。

几十年后，在1991年勒芒24小时力赛上，

安装了转子引擎的马自达787B又成为了
赢得该项赛事的首辆日本赛车。

毫无疑问，RX-7和RX-8代表了

马自达百年历史中的高光时刻之一。

而且我们可以确信，它的下一代赛车
一定会在转子引擎的历史上继续扮演领头羊角色。

records.requirementsEn: Collect: Nissan Fairlady Z 300ZX TwinTurbo 2seater (Z32) '89, Nissan Fairlady Z Version S (Z33) '07, Nissan Z Performance '23
records.requirementsZh: 收集：Nissan Fairlady Z 300ZX TwinTurbo 2seater (Z32) '89、Nissan Fairlady Z Version S (Z33) '07、Nissan Z Performance '23
records.storyEn:
These are particularly notable models from
Nissan's iconic Z sports car range.

It's a wonderful collection of cars!

Zs have been prized the world over for more than half a
century now, constantly evolving over that period.

It all started with the S30 Z, which made its debut
back in1969.

Nissan had been honing its sports car development skills
long before the Z appeared.

In the 1950s, for example, it built the first Datsun Sports,
emulating the open-top sports cars popular in Europe.

Then in the 1960s it developed the Datsun Fairlady series.

Nissan carefully researched the traditional two-seater
sports cars being produced in Europe...

And used what they learned to create an all-new kind of
spots car, one that was far more advanced: The Z.

Specifically, the original Z, the S30,
with its elegant coupe body.

The S30 looked great, and drove like a dream.

What's more, it was also not as costly as its European
counterparts.

It would also go on to do well in motorsports, including
Japanese touring car races and international rallies.

About 550,000 of these S30s were sold worldwide.

As sports cars go, it was an enomous hit.

That's how the legend of the Z began.

The next chapter takes us to 1978, when the
second-generation S130 made its debut...

...followed by the third-generation Z31 in 1983, which had
an all-new engine, bodywork and styling.

The fourth-generation Z was the Z32, which first
went on sale in 1989.

It was fitted with awtwin turbo V-6, the most powerful
that Nissan produced at that time.

It was also the first Z that featured a convertible
model.

The Z32 was beautiful to look at and was also revolutionary
in the way people had come to expect of the Z.

The fifth-generation Z, the Z33, did not appear
until 2002.

It had the unmistakable look of a Z car, and it boasted a
naturally-aspirated engine as well as a FR layout.

It was also relatively inexpensive for a s3orts car, thus
continuing the tradition started with the first Z.

The sixth-generation Z34's chassis featured a special wheelbase
which made it drive like a real FR sports car.

The latest addition to the Z range came when the
seventh-generation was launched in 2021.

The Z range has countless fans all over the world,
and many events are held for this community.

Everyone has their favorite generation and favorite mdel,
and every Z is loved by someone.

It doesn't matter which one you manage to get your hands on
in the end, for they're very special sports cars, one and all!
*
records.storyZh:
你眼前的车就是日产标志性的Fairlady Z系列
跑车中最负盛名的几款了。

说真的，这批收藏真是令人艳羡不已啊！

Fairlady Z系列已经在全世界风行了超过半个世纪，而且在这段
漫长的时间里，这些经典车型也在不断进化革新。

这段灿烂的历史发轫于1969年首次亮相的S30 Fairlady Z。

在Fairlady Z出现之前，日产便已在打磨其跑车开发能力。

例如在1950年代，这家公司就已经模仿
欧洲流行的敞篷跑车，打造出了第一代Datsun Sports。

到了1960年代，它又开发了Datsun Fairlady系列。

日产通过仔细钻研欧洲生产的传统型双座跑车……

并利用学到的心,打造出了属于自己的
全新跑车：更为先进的Fairlady Z。

具体来说就是第一代Fairlady Z——拥有优雅双门车身的S30。

S30不仅外形靓丽，还拥有梦幻般的驾驶体验。

更重要的是，它比欧洲的同类产品
在价格上更有竞争优势。

这款车在汽车运动领域也同样表现出色，参加了
如日本房车赛和国际拉力赛等多项赛事。

S30在全世界共U出了约55万辆。

在跑车领域中，如此庞大的销量意味着巨大的成功。

由此，Fairlady Z的传奇正式拉开大幕。

这段传奇的下一篇章带我们去到了1978年，
第二代S130惊艳亮相的一年……

然后在1983年，第三代Z31
也带着全新的引擎、车身和外形如约而至。

第四代Fairlady Z是1989年上市的Z32。

它采用了一部双涡轮增压V6引擎，
是当时性能最强大的日产汽车，

也是第一款推出了敞篷型号的Fairlady Z。

Z32不仅美观大方，也革新了
人们对于Fairlady Z的期望。

第五代Fairlady Z——Z33直到2002年才姗姗来迟。

它的外观回归本源，继承了Fairlady的血脉，
同时回归的还有自然进气引擎和前置后驱布局。

还延续了初代Fairlady Z的又一项传统，
成为一款超值的跑车。

第六代Z34的底盘采用了特殊的轴距设计，为它带来了
纯正的前置后驱跑车驾驶体验。

Fairlady Z家族中最新的成员是2021年
发布的第七代。

Fairlady Z系列在全世界积累了无数的拥趸，他们也为

records.storyEn:
There's probably no better-known American sports car than
the iconic Dodge Viper...

...and this is a really wonderful collection.

The Viper was first developed with the legendary
Shelby Cobra in mind.

Chrysler wanted a car that could rival the Chevrolet Corvette,
so it decided to create the Dodge brand.

The Corvette was considered "America's sports car,"
and Chrysler wanted a piece of that action.

And creating a modern-day Shelby Cobra seemed
a good place to start.

The Shelby Cobra was developed in the 1960s by Carroll
Shelby, a legendary figure in the world of motorsports.

The Cobra was an impressive machine, with a 2-seat open body,
a powerful engine, all packaged in an FR configuration.

The Dodge folks decided to install an engine of at least

in displacement, to make it a presence in any race it entered.

The Viper, billed as the second coming of the Shelby Cobra,
was introduced in 1989.

It came with 2-seater open body, and an 8,000 cc engine!

It also featured distinctive side-mounted mufflers
like the Cobra.

What's more, Carroll Shelby was involved wth
the car's design.

The first-generation Viper went on sale in 1992, and it
lived up to its billing as a modern-day Shelby Cobra.

In 1995, the GTS model was released, featuring a coupe body
and a more powerful engine...

Before long, the Viper became a fixture on the world racing
scene, appearing at Le Mans, among many other places.

The cars were known for their incredible torque
as well as the roar of their migty engines.

The second-generation Viper, released in 2002...

...and the third-gen car, released in 2012,
remained true to the original.

The Viper lasted for three generations, with every version
possessing the DNA of Shelby and the Cobra.

The original goal was achieved with the Viper, and it stands
proudly alongside the Corvette as "America's sports car."
records.storyZh:

Viper一开始的设计灵感来自于传奇的纯美式跑车谢尔比Cobra。

与当时公认为最秀的美式跑车——
雪佛兰Corvette分庭抗礼的产品。

打造一款现代版的谢尔比Cobra
显然是最适宜的立足点。

谢尔比Cobra是卡罗尔·谢尔比在1960年开发的一款跑车，
也是汽车运动世界中永远的传奇。

那是一辆性能极其强悍的跑车，
给世界汽车运动留下了深远的影响。

它采用前置5驱布局，在双座敞篷车身上安装了一台
性能强大的引擎，甚至可以容纳下排量达到
的引擎。

而这款道奇Viper最初在1989年公布时，宣传口径是
要成为谢尔比Cobra天神复临般的一辆车。

它同样采用双座敞篷车身设计，
安装一部
引擎。以及独特的侧出排气口。

records.storyEn:
Well, I’d say this collection brings together some of
the greatest works in Corvette history!

You’ve got a second-generation C2 that was the
first Corvette to carry the Stingray name.

You also have a sixth-gen C6, known for its swoopy body
and improved andling.

And finally, you’ve got a seventh-gen C7, which debuted
in 2013 to mark the model’s 60th anniversary.

A marvelous collection, indeed!

As everybody knows, the first-generation C1 of 1953
was the brainchild...

...of Harley Earl, a famous car designer
and brilliant engineer.

Keen to produce the first mass-produced sports car in the U.S.,
he poured evrything into designing the Vette.

Even after its release, he pushed the C1 to greater heights
with regular updates to its design and engine.

In fact, the Corvette’s signature V-8 engine and FR layout
date all the way back to this model.

It was followed by the C2 in 1963, called the Stingray, which
represented a big departure from the original model.

Integral to the C2's new appearance was a concet car by
Earl’s protégé, Bill Mitchell.

This concept vehicle was called the Corvette Stingray Racer.

Fitted to the race car chassis of the Corvette SS,
a first-generation project...

...its body was purposefully built by Mitchell
for competition.

The Stingray design and name were carried
over to the C2...

...and it subsequently influence3 the styling of
future generations of Corvettes...

...including the C3 in 1968 and the C4 of 1984.

Like any great sports car, performance enhancements
played a key role in the Corvette’s evolution.

Take the introduction of a well-balanced rear-mounted
transaxle assembly of the fifth-generation model...

...or the strong but lightweight chassis of
that characterized the C6 and C7.

The C8, which appeared in 2019, took a radical
departure from the norm because of its mid-engine layout.

Ford’s invention of the assembly line in 1913 made cars
a ubiquitous feature of the United States landscape.

But it wasn’t until 1953 that Chevrolet gave the country
its first mass-produced sports car.

Since its debut, the Vette has continually evolved and has
become a mainstay in the automotive marketplace.

It's not surprising that it has consistently been
considered "America's sports car."
records.storyZh:
不得不说，你收集到了科尔维特史上最伟大的几款产品！

首先是这辆第二代C2，这也是第一款被命名为
“Stingray”的科尔维特。

然后是这辆第六代C6，这款车以其紧凑的车身和
优化的操控性能而闻{于世。

最后，你还弄到了一辆第七代C7，这款在2013年
首次亮相的车也标志着这款车型诞生的60周年。

真是空前绝后的极品收藏！

众所周知，1953年推出的第一代C1
是通用汽车知名汽车设计师兼……

天才工程师哈利·厄尔的创意作品。

他矢志要打造出美国的第一款量产跑车，
于是将毕生所学统统倾注在了科尔维特的设计上。

在C1上市之后，他孜孜不倦地推出定期升级，
不断完善这款车的设计和引擎，将其推向性能巅峰。

事实上，整个科尔维特系列那标志性的V8引擎和
前置后驱布局都来源于第一代车型。

而1963年推出的第二代C2在设计上与前一代相比
则进行了大刀阔斧的修改，并打响了“Stingray”的名号。

这些改动主要是由厄尔的得意门生
比尔·米契尔创作的一款概念赛车所推动。

也就是科尔维特Stingray Racer。

这款车基于第一代开发计划
——科尔维特SS的底盘所开发……

其车身也由米契尔专为竞赛所特别打造。

C2还理所当然地继承了“Stingray”的设计和名……

并继续影响到了后续科尔维特车型的设计……

例如68年推出的C3和84年推出的C4。

和所有伟大的跑车一样，性能强化在科尔维特的
不断进化中扮演了不可或缺的角色。

其第五代车型引入了一套高度平衡的后置驱动桥总成……

而第六代和第七代则采用了高强度的轻量化底盘，
帮助Stingray在同类车型中名列前茅。

其第八代C8在2019年亮相，引入了更加激进的改变，
采用了一台中置布局的V8引擎。

福特在1913年就发明了工业流水生产线，让汽车成为了
美国社会图景中最普遍存在的标志。

但直到1953年，雪佛兰才为这个国家带来了
第一款量产跑车——科尔维特。

自从科尔维特问世至今，它从未间断地描绘出了
一幅纯种跑车更新演变的画卷。

难怪人们尊其为美国跑车的代表性车型。

records.storyEn:
What a timeless and valuable collection
of mid-engine Porsches!

I guarantee that it will be the envy of every serious
car collector.

If you’ll recall the Porsche 911 Menu Book that
you had completed a while back...

...Porsche’s first mass-produced sports car, the 356, and
the historic 911, which bowed in 1963...

...were known for their rear-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layouts.

Well, company founder Dr. Ferdinand Porsche
could have gone a different route...

...because he was one of the first to note the cornering
and steering advantages provided by a mid-engine design.

You see, more than a decade before the 356, Dr. Porsche
developed a mid-engine race car called the P-Wagen.

It was commissioned by Auto Union,
a roup made of four German automakers.

The decision to use a mid-engine layout
for superior handling balance was revolutionary for its time.

In fact, Dr. Porsche even tried to use a mid-engine chassis
for the prototype of the 356.

Alas, it ultimately took on a rear-engine/rear-drive layout, so
the 365 needed to be modified to meet various race regulations.

Looking to build a purer race model,
Porsche came up ith a genuine mid-engine sports car.

This was called the Porsche 550 Spyder.

Weighing in at a lean
, it was designed with
the engine located right behind the driver’s seat.

Having competed on such big stages as the Mille Miglia
and the 24 Hours of Le Mans...

...the 550 Spyder was a race car with great historical
importance for Porsche.

One modern model that can trace its line6ge back to the
550 Spyder is the Porsche Boxster, which appeared in 1996.

There was also a coupe iteration called the Cayman
whose fixed roof provided better chassis rigidity.

This GT4 Series car is based on the Cayman GT4 Clubsport.

It's a production sports car that allows you to experience
the feel of a genuine Porsche race machine..

And, this 918 Spyder from 2013...well, it’s another historic
mid-en$ine Porsche.

Not only did it inherit a mid-engine layout that was
established by the 550 Spyder...

its name suggests that it's related to the historic 917 race car
and 919 Hybrid, two Le Mans heroes.

It combines a race-derived mid-mounted
V-8 with two electric motors...

...that sends power to all four wheels.

It's a next-generation sports car that's, from a technical
standpoint, uniquely Porsche.

As you can imagine, I could go on about the many mid-engine
Porsches that have left a mark on automotive history.

Indeed, this is one collection that your garage
cannot do without.

我保证每一名专业的汽车收藏家都会嫉妒你！

其中有保时捷的第一款量产跑车356，
以及在1963年初次亮相、极具历史意义的911。

众所周知，这两款车均采用了后置引擎、后轮驱动布局。

当然，公司的创始人费迪南德·保时捷博士在当时
也完全可以采取一条截然不同的设计路线，

毕竟他就是最初发现中置布局设计可以提供
较佳的平衡性和转向优势的工程师之一。

其实呢，在356推出的十多年前，在由德国的
四家汽车制造商组成的联合企……

“汽车联盟”所委托下，保时捷博士就已经
开发出了一款名为“P-Wagen”的中置布局车款。

为了优化操控性而采用中置布局，
这在当时是极具革新性的决策。

事实上，保时捷博士原本也计划为356的
原型车采用一款中置布局底盘。

但最后365还是采用了后置后驱布局，导致这款车必须
要进调整才能够符合各项赛事的规则。

于是，为了打造一款更为纯粹的比赛机器，
保时捷博士设计出一款全新的中置引擎跑车，

即保时捷550 Spyder。

这款车仅重
，并且将引擎
设计在紧靠驾驶座后方的位置。

550 Spyder参加过包括意大利一千英里耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛等重大赛事，

是一款于保时捷来说具有重要历史意义的赛车。

有另一个车型就起源于这辆550 Spyder，
那就是在1996年亮相的保时捷Boxster……

以及其双门版本——Cayman，而且后者的有顶车身
确保了车身刚度得到增强。

这款GT4车型基于Cayman GT4 Clubsport所开发，

从技术角度来看，这是:款次时代跑车，

在众多历史悠久的中置布局保时捷车型中，

following the end of World War II.

A mechanic at heart, Soichiro approached competition
racing as an engineering laboratory.

His was the first Japanese company to compete
in the notoriously dangerous Isle of Man TT.

As well as the first to compete in Formula 1,
the pinnacle of motorsports.

Time and again, Honda has proven itself
on the world stage.

Outside of its motorsports achievements, Honda also
produced a number of legendary street-legal sports cars.

Among these are the S500, which debuted in 1963
and had a displacement of only
.

As well as FF models like the CR-X and Integra,
and the S2000, an FR sports car.

Debuting in 1990, the NSX represents the height
of sports car development at Honda

Taking a cue from F1 cars, Honda’s engineers gave
the NSX a mid-engine rear-wheel drive layout.

It was the world’s first production car to
have an all-aluminum, monocoque body.

From its style to its amazing handling, the NSX had it all,
making it the envy of automakers the world over.

The NSX Type R from '92 is truly legendary.
It was the fastest, most stoic NSX around.

Purged of all excess, its weight was reduced by
,
with a powerful engine and aero3ynamic underbody.

In '97, the NSX received an upgraded 3.2-liter engine
and in 2001, featured fixed headlamps.

This NSX Type R from '02 incorporates these minor changes.

Distinguished by its aerodynamic upgrades, it's capable
of sticking to the track at high speeds.

Exhibiting a smooth ride quality.

The first-generation NSX ended with this car, and i7 wasn’t
until 2016 that the name would return.

That brings us to the hybrid AWD 2017 NSX.

Like the original model, it is equipped with a V-6
engine.

It is a sports car that symbolizes the technical and creative

records.storyZh:
毫无疑问，这三辆本田改变了世界对日本跑车的看法。

所以，它们是很有价值的收藏品！

本田是由工程师本田宗一郎于1948年在日本创立的。
其时，日本刚刚经历了二战的战败。

宗一郎原本是一位机械师，他以工程实验室的身份
参与到了赛车动当中。

本田不仅是首家参加以高风险而闻名于世的
马恩岛TT摩托车赛的日本公司……

也是首家参加方程式赛事巅峰
——一级方程式赛车的日本公司。

事实上，本田曾经一次又一次地在世界舞台上
展现出自己的价值。

除了赛场上的成就本田还生产过许多台
能够合法上路的跑车。

其中就有发布于1963年、排量仅
的S500……

以及CR-X和形格等前置前驱车型，和前置后驱跑车S2000。

NSX系列发布于1990年，代表了本田跑车开发的最前沿。

本田的工程师从F1赛车中汲取灵感，为NSX选择了
中置引擎、后轮驱动4布局……

并使它成为了世界上首款使用全铝单体车壳车身的量产车。

从视觉效果到操控，NSX仿佛全无弱点，使得全世界的
汽车制造商都眼红不已。

这辆1992年的NSX Type R是一个真正的传奇。
它是最快、最干练的NSX。

在去除所有累赘之后，其重量减少了足有
。
流线ɋ的引擎和车身底板造型自然也加分不少。

在1997年，NSX将引擎排量提高到3.2升；
而在2001年，又引入了固定大灯。

这辆2002年的NSX Type R就包含了前期的所有改动。

它在空气动力学方面的表现独树一帜，在高速下
依然能牢牢地抓住路面……

让驾驶体验非常顺滑。

在这车型推出后，NSX系列暂告终结。直到2016年才得以重生。

这一次，本田带来了使用混合动力的四轮驱动2017款车型。

和原版NSX相同的是，它也配备了中置V6引擎。

但这一次，它的前后方各多了一台电机，
负责将动力输送到四个车轮。

这是一辆向本田宗一郎留下的技术
和2意遗产致敬的跑车。

The Silvia is the most elegant and sporty coupe
in Nissan’s storied existence.

The three you have assembled here were each exceedingly
popular in the 1980s and 1990s.

The handling balance of the rear-wheel-drive layout...

...and a peppy engine, all for a more-than-reasonable price
were two of several reasons for their popularity.

Really, this is a splendid collection that brings together
the best of the Silvia.

Let me start by telling you a bit about the original model,
the first-generation Silvia from 1965.

This sports coupe shared the engine and chassis
of the Nissan Fairlady 1600.

Its beautiful design was consistent with that of European
sportscars from the 1960s and 1970s.

By the way, do you know where the name "Silvia"
came from?

It was actually taken from the goddess of the forest
in Roman mythology.

This S13 Silvia is five generations removed
from the original model.

Sold between 1988 and 1993...

...it served as the base car for the 180SX, a coupe whose
main visual trait was its retractable eadlamps.

Along with the Toyota Celica and the Honda Prelude, the S13
became famous as an affordable sports coupe.

Affordability aside, its rear-wheel-drive layout,
powerful engine and innovative suspension...

...contributed to its excellent performance, making it a favorite
in Japan’s mountain-racing scene.

Japan is home to many enthusiasts of tuning
and customization.

This SilEighty, which uses parts from both the Silvia
and 180SX, is one of many fan favorites.

Outside of Japan, Silvias have been marketed
with names like the 200SX and the 240SX.

With slight variations on the Japanese Silvia in terms of
design and engine specifications...

...the 200SX and the 240SX share with their counterparts
all the qualities of an elegant and sporty FR coupe.

The successor to the pop6lar S13, this sixth-gen S14,
made its debut in 1993.

Despite its slightly larger body, it retained the sharp lines
and elegance of its predecessors.

One mustn’t forget that it also came with an updated SR20DET,
which was first introduced in the S13 models.

Later iterations of the S14 featured an even sportier
design language...

...and this trend continued with the seventh-gen S15.

Slightly more compact than the previous model, it offered
enhanced agility, making it more nimble than ever before.

In terms of styling, it was instantly recognizable as
a high-performance sports car.

Improvements to the suspension, engine, and body rigidity
all contributed to excellent performance on the road.

Ever since production of the S15 ended in 2002, Nissan has
yet to unveil a successor model.

Nevertheless, the Silvia continues to be among the most popular
and influential sports cars ever to come out of Japan.
`
records.storyZh:
Silvia系列是日产的制造史上最优雅、
最具有运动感的双门跑车。

你集齐的这三台车在八十年代和九十年代都非常有人气。

这都要得益于后轮驱动布局带来的稳定性……

和众所周知的、平易近人的价格。

这套收藏汇集了Silvia系列最好的车型，堪称经典中的经典。

让我先从原型车，也就是1965年的第一代Silvia说起吧。

它是一辆杰出的双门跑车，以日产Fairlady 1600
的引擎和底盘为基础制造。

它那优美的造型完全可以和60及70年代的欧洲跑车相提并论。

顺便，你知道“Silvia”个名字的来历吗？

这是取自罗马神话中的一位美丽而浪漫的女神。

从原型车型算起的话，这台S13 Silvia就是第五代了。

它的发售时间是1988年到1993年间……

值得一提的是，它是180SX设计时的基础参考。
后者是一款以其上翻式车头灯而闻名的双门跑车。

和丰田Celica及本田Prelde同期发售，
这辆S13作为一款价格平易近人的双门跑车而闻名。

除了价格优势，后轮驱动布局，
强劲的引擎和创新的悬挂……

都赋予了它优秀的手感，在日本跑山比赛中占尽优势。

日本的汽车调校和改装爱好者数量众多。

因此这辆使用Silvia和180SX的零件混合开发而成的
Sileighty在他们看来非常酷。kp

在日本以外的地区，Silvia以200SX和240SX等名称进行发售。

虽然在设计和引擎规格方面与日本的Silvia不尽相同，

但200SX和240SX却同样展现出一辆优雅和运动的
前置引擎双轮跑车应有的品质。

这辆第六代的S14发布于1993年，是高人气的S13的继任者。

虽然车身略微增大，
它还是保留了该系列车型的锋利条和优雅气质。

值得注意的是，它也配备了一台升级后的SR20DET引擎，
这台引擎是在S13的后期车型上引入的。

此后，S14的改款采用了更富运动感的设计语言……

这一趋势还沿续到了第七代的S15上。

S15相比前代车型更加紧凑，并凭借各方面的性能基础
实现了顺滑的操作手感。

从设计上看，一就可以将其归类于双门跑车。

悬挂、引擎和车身刚度的提升都令驾驶体验顺畅不少。

当S15的生产于2002年结束后，日产就再没有
发布继任车型了。

尽管如此，作为日本最优雅也最酷的双门跑车车系，
每一辆Silvia都称得上名副其实。

records.storyEn:
These three cars are produced by Renault, a French
manufacturer with a long history of rally and track racing.

This is a wonderful collection that really celebrates
Renault's motorsport history.

The company was founded by Louis Renault and his brothers.

Louis is perhaps best known for inventing the direct drive
system—a knd of prototype FR system of the period.

This system was fitted in a car known as a Voiturette,
which became a huge hit.

In the early 20th century, Renault succeeded in expanding
rapidly all over the world.

The company's founder, Louis Renault, soon got into motor
racing along with his brother, Marcel.

Cars produced by Louis performed wel wherever they
were raced...

And indeed, a Renault car won the first ever French Grand
Prix in 1906.

In 1926, Renault set a spectacular 24-hour speed record in a
special car based on a production model.

The company's habit of competing at the very top of the
motorsport world continued after Louis's death.

And, Renault's current cars all ive and breathe
this legacy.

The boxy appearance of this R8 Gordini belies its
radical nature.

It featured a high-performance engine designed by Amédée
Gordini, a French engineer known as "The Sorcerer."

Renault also took the rallying world by storm.

Indeed, this R5 Turbo is one of the most iconic rally cars
of all time, designed specifically to win the WC.

Originally a front-wheel drive production car,
it was converted into a mid-engine rear-wheel drive monster.

Its wide body and wide tires help allow it
to maintain grip on all types of corners.

This Renault Clio V6 is actually known as the modern-day
successor to the R5 Turbo.

It's based on the front-wheel-drive Clio and fitted
with a 3.0-liter V-6 engin&.

The Clio V6 is used for track racing, including in one-make
races organized by Renault.

Renault has a particular gift for producing surprisingly
powerful sports models from its compact cars.

Driving them requires a certain amount of skill, but once
you get the hang of it, they're a great deal of fun!
records.storyZh:
这三辆车均由法国车厂
雷诺生产。这家厂商拥有一段悠久的拉力和赛道比赛史。

这套精美的藏品纪念了
雷诺的汽车运动历史。

这家车厂是由路易斯·雷诺和他的兄弟们一起创立的。

路易斯很可能是因其发明的“直接传动系统”
而知名——相当当时的前置后驱系统原型。

这种系统被装入车辆，并被称为“Voiturette”，
随后取得巨大成功。

20世纪初，雷诺的生意成功地
在世界各地迅速扩张。

该公司的创始人路易斯·雷诺不久后便
与他的兄弟马塞尔一起投身于赛车界。

路易斯生产出的车无论
在哪7都取得了优异的竞赛表现……

1906年，法国大奖赛的桂冠首次由
一辆雷诺夺得。

1926年，雷诺用一辆基于量产车型的特殊汽车创造了
惊人的24小时速度纪录。

路易斯去世后，该公司依旧在赛车界
中叱咤争霸。

今天雷诺的赛车也
依然在赛场是驰骋着。

R8 Gordini方方正正的外表掩饰着
它激进的天性。

它搭载了一台由被称为“巫师”的法国工程师
阿梅德·戈迪尼设计的高性能发动机。

雷诺在拉力赛车界也大获成功。

R5 Turbo不愧为有史以来最具标志性的车辆之一，
其的设计初衷正是赢得世界拉力锦标赛。

雷诺将一辆前驱量产车改造成了一辆
中置后驱的拉力猛将。

它宽大的轮胎允许它在过弯时维持抓地力，
也支撑着超宽的车身。

这辆雷诺Clio V6其实是R5 Turbo
现时的后继者。

它基于前驱Clio的车体并搭载了
一台3升V6引擎。

Clio V6被用于赛道比赛，
包括由雷诺组织的单一种竞赛。

雷诺特别擅长
用紧凑的量产车改造出令人惊讶的强大运动车型。

驾驶它们需要一定的技巧，但在掌握之后，
它们就会变得乐趣无穷！

records.storyEn:
The Nissan GT-R Skyline is a super high-performance car from
Japan that is popular all over the world.

It's a production model, but everything about it was designed
for racing.

It's therefore no surprise that the Skyline GT-R has won
countless races, making it a real motorsport legend.

This collection contains threecars that form part of its
illustrious history.

The history of the Skyline GT-R goes back to the 1960s.

This 2000 GT-R, known as the "Hakosuka," was released in
1969. It was based on the third-generation Skyline.

Its predecessor, the Prince Skyline GT, was fitted with
a six-cylinder engine specifically for racing.

So, this model, designed to win touring car races had
an engne that was totally different to the retail version:

It was a newly developed 2.0-liter, inline-6 S20 engine, based
on the engine in the Nissan R380, a pure race car.

This GT-R-based car would go on to win pretty much every
major race in Japan.

The following year, in 1970, a 2-door hard-top GT-R with
improved performance was added to the lineup.

This 2-door GT-R also dominated races, at one point winning
49 consecutive domesticraces.

As the 1970s went on, however, Nissan was gradually forced
to suspend their motorsport activities.

A completely revamped Skyline GT-R was released in 1973...

...but the influence of the oil shock and the very strict
emissions restrictions placed on performance cars...

...meant that they were only in production for three months,
with only around 200 units being built.

Tis GT-R, referred as the "Kenmeri," never
had the opportunity to enter a race.

But its dramatic story has become a part of
the GT-R's folklore.

Nissan then took a break from producing GT-Rs for racing
purposes...

...until, in 1989, when the first GT-R in 16 years was
introduced, based on the eighth-generation Skyline.

That car was this famous model, known as the R32 GT-R.

It was developed with the Gr.A races of the period in mind,
and fitted with a specially produced 2.6-liter twin turbo engine.

It also featured Nissan's unique 4-wheel drive system,
which provided handling that rivalled FR cars.

A car based on the R32 GT-R won the All-Japan Touring Car
Championship four years in a row!

From its beginnings in 1969, the legend of the Skyline GT-R
continues to this day.

And shows no signs of being over yet!

Indeed, i seems clear that there are still many chapters
yet to be written!
records.storyZh:
日产GT-R Skyline是一款在全球备受推崇的
日产巨星跑车。

这款车虽然是零售车型，但它的一切都
是面向赛车设计的。

因此不出意料，Skyline GT-R赢得了无数场比赛，
成为了真正的赛车运动传奇。

这一系列中包含了三辆铸就这段
辉煌历史的汽v。

Skyline GT-R的历史要从上世纪六十年代说起。

这辆2000 GT-R，别名“Hakosuka”，是一款
于1969年上市的车型。它基于第三代Skyline。

它的前代车型Prince Skyline GT搭载着一台
竞速用六缸引擎……

因此这款为赢得房车赛而设计的车型，
其发动机与市售版完全不同：

基于日产R380的发动机发的2升直列六缸S20发动机
，俨然是一款纯粹的赛车。

这款基于GT-R的车型几乎称霸了所有
主要日本赛事。

隔年，也就是1970年，一款性能更强的双门硬顶GT-R
也加入了行列。

这款双门GT-R也称霸了所有赛事，甚至一度达成了
49场国内连胜。

过了几年，日产被迫逐步暂停了
他们的赛事活动。

1973年，一款完全重制的Skyline GTR问世……

但是，受制于石油危机的影响和对高性能
车辆的严格排放限制……

使得这款车型只投产了三个月，
总产量仅有200辆。

这辆在广告中被称为“Kenmeri”的GT-R，
从未得到参赛的机会……

但其充满戏剧性的故事意味着它是GT-R传奇中
不可或缺的一部分。

后日产暂停了赛事用GT-R
的生产……

直到1989年，16年来的第一辆GT-R诞生：
一辆基于第八代Skyline的GT-R。

其最终成果便是这款被称作R32 GT-R的车型。

它是专门针对当年的A组别赛事开发的，并配备了为其
专门生产的2.6升双涡轮增压发动机。

它还拥有日产独特的四轮驱动系统，
使其操控性可与前置后驱车相媲美。

一辆基于R32 GT-R的赛车连四年赢得了全日房车
锦标赛的全部比赛——连续赢下29场赛事！

从1969年开始，Skyline GT-R的传奇
一直延续至今……

而且还没有结束的迹象！

看来这款车确实还会书写
许多传奇！

records.storyEn:
These three inline-6-powered BMWs are the picks of their
respective eras. A magnificent collection indeed!

BMW, or "Bavarian Motor Works," was a company
that was founded on engine-building.

Its emblem that signifies a spinning propeller suggests
that the company started with aircraft engines.

In 1917, it released its first product, an inline-6
engine called the BMW IIIa.

Touted as a "perfectly balanced engine," the inline-6 layout
cancelled out the rocking motion of the cylinders.

Offering high reliability and performance, it was used
to power many famous airplanes.

Having made a name for itself in engine production,
BMW next turned to automobiles...

...producing many renowned cars and automobile engines.

But the highest praise has always been reserved
for its "smooth-as-silk" inline-6.

The E46 M3, the company's venerable sports sedan, was the
last M3 to come equipped with a naturally-aspirated inline-6.

Not only is its S54 3.2-liter engine powerful and responsive,
it als roars like a lion.

Although BMW also built V8s for the M3,
it never abandoned the inline-6.

The M2 Competition is one excellent example
of this return to form.

Propelled by a twin-turbo 3.0-liter inline-6, this compact
is capable of hitting exotic-car speeds.

Tracing your way along the M family tree, you're bound
to come across many great inline-6-powered cars.

And the 3.0 CSL from 1973 is definitel. one of them.

Fitted with a 3.0-liter inline-6, and later a 3.2-liter version,
this machine was a major player in touring car races.

Some 130 years have passed since automobiles
adopted the internal-combustion engine...

...yet few have left their mark on history quite like
BMW’s ever-evolving inline-6.
records.storyZh:
这三辆直列六缸宝马都是它们各自时代的一时之选。
确实是一批令人艳羡的收藏！

宝马，或者说“巴伐利亚引擎制造厂”，正如其名称所示，
是一家以制造引擎起家的公司！

不过追述企业历史，其第一批引擎是为飞机，
而不是汽车设计的。

在1917年，该公司发布了其首款产品，
一台名为宝马IIIa的直列六缸引擎。

这台引擎被誉为“完美平衡的引擎”，直列六缸布局
成功消除了气缸的所有振动。

作为一台可靠性与性能俱佳的引擎，它被安装在了
数不清的著名飞机上。

成功在引擎开发史上留名之后，宝马开^进入汽车制造业……

虽然生产了许多闻名遐迩的汽车和汽车引擎，

但得到最多赞誉的永远是他们“顺滑如丝”的
直列六缸引擎车型。

E46 M3就是他们这个领域的主要成就之一，也最后一款
搭载自然吸气直列六缸引擎的M3。

这台代号S5443.2升引擎不仅响应灵敏，声势
更如狮吼般雄浑洪亮。

虽然宝马后来开始为M3搭载V8引擎，但也从未放弃过
自己的直列六缸引擎。

M2 Competition就是其回归的杰出代表之一。

它由一台3升直列六缸双涡轮增压引擎驱动，
如同一枚小巧的导弹，却能够达到火箭级的速度。

在M家族的车系中一路追溯，你还能发现
许多了不起的直列六缸车型……

而1973年的3.0 CSL必然会是其中之一。

这辆传奇汽车最初装载了一台3升直列六缸引擎，
后来又升级为3.2升，是各类房车锦标赛中的常客。

从汽车采用内燃机引擎开始，已经过去了130余年……

但很少有汽车能像宝马这些不断进化的直列六缸汽车一样，
在历史上留下鲜明的印记！

Headquartered in France, Bugatti is a truly unique brand,
the very name of which is nothing short of legendary.

Part of its appeal is a strong association with the most
elegant and high-performing cars in the world.

Born into an artistic family in Milan, company founder
Ettore Bugatti was a skilled mechanical engineer.

In 1909, he established an autmaking company in Molsheim,
now part of the Alsace region of France.

Producing many excellent road and race cars, he steadily
built his brand’s reputation.

The Bugatti Type 35 from 1924 is a perfect example
of Ettore’s craft.

Among its 1000-plus wins were two straight wins at the
Monaco Grand Prix and five at the Targa Florio.

Back then, Bugatti cars were distinguished by their bright
blue bodies, a traition that continues to this day.

Ettore passed away in 1947, at which point his company
ceased operations.

It wasn’t until 1987 that an Italian entrepreneur acquired
the brand and revived the famed automaker.

Although Bugatti returned to the spotlight with the EB110,
it once again ceased operations in 1995.

After that, Volkswagen Group stepped in to finance
a third revial of the legendary brand.

Returning to Molsheim, Bugatti Automobiles once again created
some of the world’s greatest cars.

and was purchased through a secret bid.

to the Veyron.

Based on the Vision Gran Turismo model, its W-16 engine

records.storyZh:
总部设在法国的布加迪是一个真正独一无二的名牌，
永远不乏传奇故事的诞生。

它的强大魅力部分要归功于其旗下那些
世界上性能最高、设计最优雅的车型。

公司创始人埃托雷·布加迪出身于米兰的艺术世家，本人也是
一位技艺精湛的机械工程师。

1909年，他在莫{塞姆小镇（现属于法国阿尔萨斯）
创立了一家汽车制造公司。

通过生产优秀的公路车和比赛用车，他稳健地
积累了品牌的口碑。

1924年的布加迪35型是埃托雷作品的代表。

此车斩获了超过1000个冠军头衔，其中包括蝉联
摩纳哥大奖赛冠军，以及摘得塔格·佛罗热大赛的五届冠军。

当时，布加迪汽车以其亮蓝色!车身而出名，

埃托雷于1947年去世，公司经营也随之终止。

直到1987年，一位意大利企业家收购了这一品牌，

虽然布加迪凭借EB110再次获得了瞩目，但却于1995年

此后，大众集团为这个传奇名牌V入了

布加迪汽车回到莫尔塞姆，开始设计出一批

它搭载一台1000马力的W16引擎，

在虚拟世界里，布加迪也通过

2016年亮相的Chiron是布加迪Veryron的继任车型，

基于Vision Gran Turismo车型设计，W16引擎

。

records.storyEn:
Much of the innovation behind Honda’s engineering was driven by
competition, and these three are shining examples of that!

Company founder Soichiro Honda was a firm believer
in the notion that racing improves technology.

After racing motorcycles in competitions all over the world,
he channeled his experience into building cars.

In 1964, one year after Honda unveiled its first
production car, the T360 pickup...

...the company earned the distinction of being the first Japanese
automaker to compete in Formula 1 racing.

After some hardships, Honda won its first race in the final round of its
second year, the 1965 Mexican Grand Prix.

The car that made Honda’s F1 victory a reality
was none other than this Honda RA272.

Honda was quick to pick up on the importance
of having a designated competition track.

Looking to build Japan’s first genuine race track,
Honda helped develop the Suzuka Circuit in 1962.

The Honda S series sports car was the first to compete
on this track in 1964.

And it went on to achieve a lass win at the Nürburgring
in Germany in the same year.

The car became an important part of Honda’s
motorsports history.

As for this F1 machine, the McLaren MP4/4, it was a major
player of the 1980s, an era dominated by turbo engines.

The 1988 F1 season was brutal for F1 teams
that relied on turbocharged engines.

This is because 1988 was the year in which
tight limits were put on turbo technologyy

Undismayed, Honda poured all of its know-how into
fine-tuning the MP4/4’s turbocharged powerplant.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, McLaren won
15 of 16 races in a single year!

Indeed, this is a collection that wonderfully expresses
Soichiro Honda’s ardent passion for racing!
records.storyZh:
竞赛是本田汽车设计革新背后最大的驱动力之一，
而这三辆车就是证明！

公司创始人本田宗一郎是“竞争提升科技”
这一观点的坚定信仰者。

在参与过全世界各项摩托车赛事之后，
他将自己的经验倾注在了汽车制造领域。

{1964年，也就是本田发布了他们的第一款
量产车——T360皮卡的一年之后……

这家公司光荣地成为了第一家参加F1锦标赛的日本车厂。

他们的征程起初并不顺利，不过在参赛次年1965年的
最后一站比赛中，车队赢下了墨西哥大奖赛的胜利。

而让本田的F1夺冠梦想成真的赛车，
正是这辆本田RA272。

它采用了本田自己设计开发!V12引擎和车身，
是赛车运动史上的一款传奇车型。

本田拥有独一无二的领悟力，很快就意识到
拥有自己的专属赛道的重要性。

他们立志于打造全日本第一个真正的赛车场，
并在1962年参与建设了铃鹿赛道。

第一批在这条铃鹿赛道上比赛的赛车中就有
于1964年亮相的本田S系列跑车。

随后，这一系列车型于U一年在德国的纽博格林赛道上
又赢下了一场组别赛事的胜利，

成为本田参与赛车运动的历史上最不可或缺的推动者。

至于这辆F1赛车——迈凯伦MP4/4，它在由
涡轮增压引擎所统治的1980年代大放异彩。

对于严重依赖强大的涡轮增压引擎的所有F1车队来说，
1988赛季尤其艰难。

因为在这一年，赛事大会针对轮增压技术实施了
极其严苛的限制。

但本田并未心灰气馁，而是调动起全部的知识和经验，
精细调校MP4/4的涡轮增压引擎。

通过与车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特的通力合作，

他们在那一年惊人地赢下了16场比赛中的15场，
以势不可挡之姿拿下了F1总冠军！

毋庸置疑，这一次的收藏完美呈现了
本田宗一郎对于赛车的诚挚热情！

records.storyEn:
The Ford GT is celebrated the world over as one of the
greatest race cars in motorsports history.

Here we have a 1960s original Ford GT Mk I,
and its second-gen successor.

This is an incredible collection that is sure to be the
envy of any serious gearhead.

History buffs are surely aware of Ford’s fascinating
racing history.

...entered one of his cars in a U.S. race, unexpectedly
defeating his more successful rival.

It was a brilliant show of endurance and speed that
put Ford on the map in competition endurance racing.

In the 1960s, Ford placed its focus on the
Le Mans 24-hour race.

After partnering with veteran British engineering firm Lola Cars,
Ford established Ford Advanced Vehicles.

In 1964, the company then unveiled a prtotype race car called
the "Ford GT."

Although it was developed to win at Le Mans...

...a mass-production version was offered the following year.

Then came the GT Mk I, and its mere 40-inch height
led to it being named the "GT40."

An important contributor to the Ford GT Le Mans project...

...was the legendary U.S. race car driver and master
automotive developer Carroll Shelby.

With Shelby’s help, an improved ariant, called the Mk II,
appeared in 1966.

This car brought Ford a fabulous victory at Le Mans.

Notably, that win not only unseated Ferrari as
the reigning Le Mans champion...

...but the GT40 did so in absolutely dominant fashion,
finishing 1-2-3!

From then until 1969, Ford introduced new variants and scored
four con$ecutive Le Mans victories...

...securing its legacy in the annals of motorsport history.

This legacy has continued into the 21st century...

...particularly in the form of this Ford GT, introduced in 2005
to mark the company's centennial.

It reimagined the beautiful form of the 1960s' GT40
with state-of-the-art technology.

This second-coming of the mid-engine Le Mans winner
had a stunning design and awesome performance.

But the legend of the Ford GT did not stop there...

...because a more evolved GT was unveiled
in 2015.

This new model competed in the 2016 Le Mans,
where it pulled off a stunning class victory.

This achievement happened to mark the 50th anniversary
of Ford’s first Le Mans win.

The Ford GT is a rare breed of sports car that shined
on the world stage for more than half a century.
records.storyZh:
作为赛车运动史上最伟大的成就之一，
福特GT得到了全世界的盛誉。

在这里的是一辆1960年代产初代福特GT Mk I，
以及它的第二代后续车型。

这两辆车都是非常了不起的收藏品，
一定会让所有硬核汽车迷艳羡不已。

汽车历史爱好者想必都对福特那令人;往的赛车史如数家珍。

在1901年，公司的创始人亨利·福特……

派出他的一辆汽车参与了一项美国赛事，
并意外地击败了实力更为强大的对手。

那是一场耐力与速度的精彩演出，
也确立了福特参与赛车运动的传统。

在上世纪60年代，福特开始布局勒芒24小时耐力赛。

福特和经验老到的英国工程公司罗拉赛车合作，
设立了福特高级车辆公司Y…

到了1964年，他们公布了一款名为“福特GT”的原型赛车。

这款车最初的设计目的就是为了在勒芒夺魁……

它的量产型号也在下一年亮相。

这款量产车便是GT Mk I，而它仅有40英寸高的车身
也让它得名“GT40”。

传奇美国赛车手兼汽车设计大师卡罗尔·谢尔比……

也是福特GT勒芒项目的一名重要贡献者。

在谢U比的帮助下，一款改良型号——Mk II于1966年登场亮相……

并在勒芒为福特拿下了一场美妙的胜利。

最值得一提的是，这场胜利不仅将统治勒芒的
冠军车厂法拉利赶下了宝座……

还创下了令人不可思议的包揽前三名之壮举，
秀出了福特那压倒性的实力！

从那一年起直到1969年，福特不断推出新款赛车，
并成功在勒芒拿下了四连冠……

巩固了自己在赛车运动史上不可磨灭的地位。

这份光荣传统在21世纪得到了延续。

比如这辆2005年亮相的福特GT，
标志着福特汽车的百年历史。

它以当时最先进的科技重新构想了60年代
GT40那美轮美奂的外观。

这款再次以中布局称霸勒芒的冠军车型也
拥有无出其右的精美外观。

不过，福特GT的传奇并未就此停下脚步……

一款全新进化的福特GT在2015年盛大登场。

新车参加了2016年的勒芒比赛，
并以独步天下的英姿拿下了胜利。

这项佳绩恰好为福特在勒芒首次夺冠
的50周年纪念送上了完美的礼物。

诚然，福特GT已经成为独树一帜的跑车族，
在世界舞台上闪耀超过半个世纪。

records.storyEn:
The name of the Shelby American car company
originated from its founder, Carroll Shelby.

Shelby worked his way up from the amateur ranks to become
an icon who competed in Formula 1 and at Le Mans.

But perhaps he is better known as one of America's most
cherished race-car designers.

One of Shelby's greatet achievements as a designer...

...happened in 1961 when he ordered a race-car
chassis from Britain's AC Cars.

This chassis was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine and took the
name Shelby Cobra.

It dominated sports-car races of the 1960s becoming
a legend in the American racing scene.

Among the most celebrated of all of Shelby's
creations is the 427 Cobra.

With a 7.0-liter V-8 engine fitted into its cassic yet robust
body, it snatched the podium in numerous races.

Shelby's efforts did not end with the Cobra, he also transformed
the production Ford Mustang into a high-performance muscle car.

The most well-known model is this 1965 Shelby GT 350, a
homologation car developed to dominate the race track.

With a displacement of 289 cubic inches, or 4.7 liters, this V-8
masterpiece turned the Mustang into a frmidable classic.

Carroll Shelby passed away in 2012, but his
legacy and his spirit live on in these cars.

Take for example the 2016 Ford Shelby GT350R, which
took the already nimble modern Mustang...

...and made it lighter, tuning the entire car, from the engine
to the chassis, to make it a true Shelby.

Carroll Shelby was, after all, the man who helped the Ford GT40
conq"er Le Mans in the 1960s.

This wonderful collection will show you his  extraordinary
passion for cars and enthusiasm for racing.
records.storyZh:
Shelby品牌的名字不言自明，来自于一个叫
卡罗尔·谢尔比的美国人。

谢尔比从业余联赛车手起步，通过自己的不懈努力
最终成为了参与F1和勒芒的传奇赛车手。

另外，他也是一名让全美国都引以为傲的知名赛车设计师。

他作为汽车0计师最伟大的成就之一……

始于1961年，当时他从英国的AC汽车公司
订购了一台赛车底盘。

然后在底盘上安装了一部福特V8引擎，
而这件作品就是后世众所周知的Shelby Cobra。

这款车统治了二十世纪六十年代的跑车赛事，
并成为了美国赛车界的传奇。

不过在所有Shelby Cobra车型中，
最著名的当属427 Cobra。

在它经典而皮实的车身下，是一台全新的7升V8引擎，
帮助它在无数场比赛中登上了领奖台。

除了Cobra之外，谢尔比还将福特野马
打造成了一辆高性能肌肉车。

其中最著名的车款就是这辆1965款Shelby GT350，
它是一辆专为统治赛道而生的赛事认证车。

这款杰作采用一台289立方英寸，或者说4.7升V8引擎，
让野马成了不可替代的一代经典。

卡罗尔·谢尔比在2012年辞世，不过他却为汽车行业
留下了宝贵的财富，他的精神也流传了下来。

2016款福特Shelby GT350R就充分地继承了他的遗产。
这款车的研发基于操控灵活、敏捷的现代野马……

进一步减轻了车重，从引擎到底盘对全车各处
进行深度调校，将其打造成了一部真正的She;by。

卡罗尔·谢尔比——帮助福特GT40在
二十世纪六十年代征服勒芒的男人。

这套美妙的收藏将会为你展示他对于汽车的无上热情
和对于比赛的执着热爱。

records.storyEn:
Surely every car enthusiast has heard of the name "Alpine."

France is known as the birthplace of motorsports,
so it makes sense that the company was founded there.

Alpine has always had a unique approach to sports car design,
it is recognized for its impressive team of race engineers.

Jean Rédélé was still a young man when he founded
the company.

While working at a Renault garage...

...he competed in races with a Renault 4CV
that he had tuned himself.

His excellent skills behind the steering wheel shined
at the Mille Miglia and other major events.

In 1955, Rédélé established his own brand, Alpine,
which was named after the Cupe des Alpes.

In 1963, Alpine officially began building race cars for
Renault under the moniker "Alpine Renault."

One of the most successful sports cars to bear the Alpine
name is this Alpine A110.

The striking design of the rear-engine compact sports car
made it a symbol for the brand.

The A110’s status as a formidable racer was established
at internationa rallies.

In 1971, it claimed a 1-2-3 finish at Monte Carlo, and in 1973,
it won the inaugural World Rally Championship.

Although Alpine took a back seat to Renault in sports car
development throughout the 1990s...

...the brand was revived in 2016 with
an all-new A110.

Rumor has it that this car was designed using Rédélé’s
original as 6 point of reference.

And indeed, elements of past A110s and Alpine’s history as
a whole are clearly evident.

Today, Alpine’s unsurpassed motorsport history and
design philosophy...

...are marvelously expressed in the Alpine Vision
Gran Turismo.

Truly, this is a magnificent collection of some of France’s
most iconic automotive treasures.
records.storyZh:
每一个车迷肯定都听说过“阿尔派”这个品牌。

阿尔派成立于二十世纪五十年代的法国，
这里也是赛车运动的诞生地……

阿尔派在跑车设计上的思路总是与众不同，
其麾下的精锐赛车工程师团队也举世闻名。

在创立这家公司时，让·雷德尔还相当年轻。

当时他在一座雷诺汽车修理厂工作……

同时也开着一辆自己调校的雷诺4CV四处参加比赛。

他开着这辆高性能雷诺在一千英里耐力赛
和其他各项重大赛事中为自己打响了名声。

在1955年，雷德尔创立了自己的品牌阿尔派，
这个名字3来源于阿尔卑斯山拉力赛。

在1963年，阿尔派正式开始以“阿尔派雷诺”的名义
为雷诺开发赛车。

阿尔派旗下最成功的一款跑车就是这辆阿尔派A110。

这是一辆后置引擎的紧凑型跑车，而其美观的设计
也成为了这一品牌的标志性符号。

A110的传奇地位是在各项国际拉力赛上赢+来的。

在1971年，它在蒙特卡洛包揽了前三名，而在1973年，
它又赢得了首届世界拉力锦标赛。

阿尔派的跑车开发业务在整个二十世纪九十年代
退居于雷诺之后……

但在2016，这个品牌又得以重振，并推出了全新一代A110。

这款新车的设计明显大量参考了雷德尔̈́初代型号……

并且从车头到车尾都遵循着A110和阿尔派的历史。

而现如今，阿尔派那传奇版的赛车运动历史和设计理念……

又通过这辆阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo
得到了充分地体现。

这套伟大的收藏为大家忠实展现了
法国汽车行业中最璀璨的一颗明珠。

records.storyEn:
This is a collection of awesome cars that have won the
"SEMA Gran Turismo Award"...

...that celebrates cool, high-performance cars.

If you're wondering what SEMA is, it stands for
Specialty Equipment Market Association...

...a group establised in 1963 to bring together businesses
involved in the manufacturing...

...and marketing of high-performance automotive parts.

And, they put on the famous SEMA Show,
an automotive aftermarket trade show...

...held in Las Vegas every year on the first week of November.

The SEMA GT Award was a title presented by Gran Turismo that was
part of a sponsorship deal that began in 2003.

In the U.S. there has long beena deep-rooted culture of car
customization and performance tuning.

American car enthusiasts improved the performance and
style of their cars, beginning with hot rods in the 1930s.

The SEMA GT Award pays homage to the shining jewels
of this custom car culture.

It provides fans around the world the chance to experience
these cars through Gran Turismo.

This Mach Forty wa the recipient of the GT Award in 2012,
produced by Eckert's Rod and Custom of Oregon.

At first, glance it looks like a 1969 Ford Mustang...

...but on the inside, it's a monster machine with a
mid-mounted Ford GT V-8 engine!

The SEMA GT Award has been given not only to American hot rods,
but to European- and Japanese-tuned cars as well.

The Fugu Z based on the Nissan 240Z is a winner from 2015, and its owner
Sung Kang is an a4tor from the "Fast and the Furious" movies.

The Rocket Bunny body kit is especially menacing...

...and the car comes powered by a naturally-aspirated
version of the famed RB26 Skyline GT-R engine.

More than a few winners of the SEMA GT Awards
began life as unassuming road cars...

...but then transformed into tarmac-eating monster machines.

The 2018 winner by the Greening Auto Company...

...took a relatively compact Ma5erick and turned it into a hot rod.

It was packed with a fully tuned 427 cu-in. V-8, which resulted
in a 200-mph top speed (approx. 322km/h)!

It’s all about seeing how far you can take
your dreams with your car...

...and the SEMA GT Award is a perpetual embodiment of that endeavor.

records.storyZh:
“SEMA超跑大奖”专门颁发给外形炫酷、性能强大的汽车，
而这批收藏中就包含几辆曾经赢得过这项大奖的顶尖名车。

如果你还不知道SEMA是什么，我可以科普一下，
这几个字母代表“美国汽车用品改装车协会”

该组织成立于1963年，旨在联合美国所有制造和经营
高性能汽车配件的企业和改装厂。

这个协会于每年11月的第一周在拉斯维加斯举办全球知名的
汽车副厂零件展销活动——“美国汽车用品改装车展览会”。

而“SEMA超跑大奖”则是一项自2003年起由作为赞助方之一的
《跑车浪漫旅》所颁发的奖项。

美国在汽车改装以及性能调校方面拥有着
历史悠久且根深蒂固的文化。

美国车迷们热衷于提升他们汽车的性能和外观，
这种“改装车”文化早在1930年代就已见端倪，

而“SEMA超跑大奖”的创立就是为了向
改装车文化王冠上的这颗明珠致敬，

并通过《跑车浪漫旅》向全世界的车迷们
提供体验这些改装X的机会。

这辆由埃克特改装车和俄勒冈定制所打造的
Mach Forty是2012年超跑大奖的获奖者。

粗略来看，它和1969款福特Mustang非常相似，

但骨子里却是安装了一台中置福特GT V8引擎的怪兽比赛机器。

“SEMA超跑大奖”并不是美国改装车的专属，
欧洲和日本的改装车也有机会获得这项殊荣。

基于日产240Z造的这辆Fugu Z是2015年的奖项得主，
而且它的主人正是出演了《速度与激情》系列的著名影星姜成镐！

全套火箭兔车身套件上身后，显得威慑感十足，

车体内则安装了享有盛誉的RB26天际线GT-R
引擎的自然进气版本。

在当选“SEMA超跑大奖”的获奖作品中，还有为数不少是将
原本平平无奇的公路车打造成彻头彻尾的性能怪兽。

I2018年的获奖者由格林宁汽车公司带来，

他们将一辆相对紧凑的Maverick改头换面。

这辆车配备了全面调校、排量4.27升的福特V8引擎，
能带来高达200英里/小时（约每小时322公里）的极速！

改装车的一切意义就在于让你的车承载着你的梦想向远方奔驰，

而“SEMA超跑大奖”正是这项追求的永恒体现。

records.storyEn:
Many rally fans know about the Subaru WRX’s stellar performance
at the World Rally Championships (WRC).

What is not so known is that the WRX takes its name from
a Subaru car from the 1970s.

I’m talking about the Leone RX, a passenger car
that was introduced in 1970.

It made its claim to fame in 1974 with an overall victory
at the notoriously callenging Japan Alpine Rally.

In later years, Subaru experienced remarkable success
on the world rally stage.

One famous car that resulted from its achievements
was the first-generation Impreza WRX.

Its name was contrived by "WR" that stood for "World
Rally," and "RX," which referred to the legendary Leone.

The first-generation Impreza WRX was a small-but-tough car
equippedwith a mighty turbo engine and 4-wheel-drive.

During the 1990s, it won several WRC championships,
cementing its name in the annals of world rally history.

This second-generation WRX, developed to carry on
its predecessor’s legacy, achieved its own rally successes.

In addition to being the last Impreza to win a WRC drivers’
championship in 2003...

...it pulled off a marvelous victory at the 2004 Rally Japan,
the first WRC event to be held on Japnese soil.

In 2014, the WRX was reborn as the Subaru WRX,
a new sports sedan...

...which has competed in the world’s most demanding races,
including the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The WRX ranks at the top of every Subaru sports-car
enthusiast, making this a splendid collection indeed.

records.storyEn:
Way back in the medieval age of Europe, knights
competed on horseback to see...

..who could reach their lord the fastest
in a type of "proto-rally race."

Flash forward to recent times, and, in a way, you’ll find the
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution carried on that tradition.

A brand with deep roots in racing, Mitsubishi participated
in international rallies beginning in the 1960s.

From 1983, its 4WD Pajero scored numerous victories at the
Dakar Rally, considered the world’s toughest off-road race.

And the Colt and Galant both experienced much success
at the World Rally Championship, which began in 1973.

Thi turbocharged 4WD Lancer Evolution made its debut in 1993,
at the height of the company's racing prowess.

At the time, the top category in the WRC consisted of
Group A cars, or largely unmodified production cars.

Based on the Lancer mid-size sedan, the "Evo"
was created as a competition machine from the get-go.

In addition to its numerous victories at the WRC,
this Evo...

...enjoyed an intense rivalry with the
Subaru Impreza, another Japanese rally powerhouse.

This 1995 Lancer Evolution III is the
third-generation model.

It was the car that handed ace rally driver Tommi
Mäkinen his first world rally drivers title.

That same year Mitsubishi introduced the true
second-generation Lancer Evolution.

Joining the Lancer Evolution VI lineup was a special version
called the Tommi Mäkinen Edition.

As Mitsubishi's ace pilot, Mäkinen was the first driver
in WRC history to win four consecutive drivers titles.

Therefore, the commemorative model that bears
his name is undeniably special.

By the time the Evo X went on sale in 2007, Mitsubishi had
withdrawn from the WRC.p

Therefore, the "X" was the last Evo to be offered.
And due its amazing performance, it will be remembered.

A Japanese WRC legend, the Lancer Evolution is a name
etched in the annals of world automotive history.
records.storyZh:
在以前的欧洲中世纪，骑士们会骑乘战马展开竞技……

这可以算作是“最原始的拉力”比赛，
看谁能够更快地赶到他们的领主身旁。

时间快进到现代赛车运动，你会发现
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神便继承了这种传统。

三菱这个品牌深深植根于赛车运动，自从
二十世纪六十年代起便一直参与国际拉力赛事。

从1983年算起，品牌旗下的四驱车帕杰罗在全世界最艰苦的
越野赛事——达喀尔拉力赛中多次夺魁……

另外，其小马和格兰特车型也在1973年创始的
世界拉力锦标赛中取得过辉煌的成功。

这款涡轮增压的四驱蓝瑟翼豪陆神在这家车厂位于
实力巅峰的1993年首次亮相。

当时，世界拉力锦标赛的顶级组别仅限于组别A赛车
——即基本未经改装的量产车参加。

“翼豪陆神”车型基于中型轿车蓝瑟所打造，
在量产车型阶段便已经为参加拉力赛做好了准备。

除了在世

也因为和当时日本的另外一款伟大车型斯巴鲁翼豹
之间的良性竞争而著称。

这辆1995年发布的蓝瑟翼豪陆神III是翼豪陆神的第三代车型。

正是这台享誉世界的赛车帮助三菱的王牌车手
托米·马基宁拿下了他的第一个世界拉力锦标赛车手冠。

同一年里，车型的改款升级也标志着Evo“真正”进入第二阶段。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI: 汤米·马基宁版便是这一革命性
飞跃的体现。

三菱的王牌车手托米·马基宁是世界拉力锦标赛
历史上第一个连续四年夺得车手冠军的人。

而这款以他名字命名的纪念车也理所当然
是一份真正的宝藏。

当翼豪陆神X在2007年开始发售时，三菱已经
退出了世界拉力锦标赛。

作为最后一款翼豪陆神，X的S-AWC系统和强大的涡轮增压引擎
让它成为了一款备受珍视且历久弥新的运动轿车。

作为日本拉力传奇，蓝瑟翼豪陆神的名字
早已被镌刻在了世界汽车历史上。

英国最著名的汽车制造商阿斯顿马丁曾经打造出

这家历史悠久的公司的起源最早可追溯到1913年。

在这一年，罗伯特·班福德和莱昂内尔·马丁
联手创立了班福特 & 马丁公司。

当他们的第一辆跑车“Coal Scuttle”在西8敦的

“阿斯顿马丁”的品牌名便诞生了，以向他们获胜的场地和

kei-cars, and what a splendid collection it is!

There's the Suzuki Cappuccino, a genuine FR sports car...

...and the mid-engine MR Honda Beat and the Mazda AZ-1,
all of them making their debuts in the 1990s.

affectionately called "the A-B-C trio."

The Daihatsu Copen, from the 2000s, is a luxurious 2-seater
with an electric convertible roof.

And the mid-engine Honda S660 is a modern remake of
the Beat that is pure sports car.

With their restricted dimensions and engine capacity, these three
belong to Japan’s smallest car category called the "kei-car."

In addition to their distinctive size, they are beloved for
their affordable price tagand robust performance.

Indeed, the kei-car played a major role in fostering
Japan’s popular car culture.

The kei-car class originated in 1949,
following the end of World War II.

While engine sizes were initially limited to

 -limit was introduced in the 1950s...

And three years later, in 1958, the now-classic Subaru 360

这几辆车都是日本独有的“轻型车”类别中
最光芒四射的成员，真是无与伦比的收藏！

在你手里的是一辆铃木Cappuccino，
这是一辆纯正的前置后驱跑车……

它和同样风格独具的本田Beat以及马自达AZ-1
都是在90年代推出的车型。

车迷们将这三款车的首字母连起来，
亲切地9呼它们为“ABC三重奏”。

这辆在2000年后开始生产的大发Copen是一款采用
电动敞篷车顶的豪华双座跑车。

而中置布局的本田S660则是本田Beat的现代重制款，
也是一款纯正的跑车。

受限于车身尺寸和引擎排量，这三款车
属于日本最小的汽车类别——“轻型车”。

轻型车类别起源于1949年，在第二次世界大战结束以后。

起初这个类型的引擎排量被限制在
和

，然后又在50年代放宽到了
……

吸引众多日本制造商开始专门为
大众打造物美价廉的轻型车。

于是，1950年代标志着一新时代的到来：
个人拥有汽车的时代。

1955推出的Suzulight荣登为
日本第一款量产的轻型车。

三年后的1958年，令人难忘的斯巴鲁360

records.storyEn:
From kei cars to large SUVs to fullsize trucks,
Toyota has built them all.

Introduced in 2017, the GR series is Toyota’s range of
sports cars with a direct link to motorsports.

The cars in this series are built by Toyota Gazoo Racing
(TGR), Toyota’s in-house racing division.

Take any one ofthem for a test drive, and you’ll instantly
see what makes them special.

A key figure behind these cars was Hiromu Naruse,
Toyota’s former master test driver.

During his many years at the company, Naruse not only served
as the top test driver but also its guardian of driving flavor.

There’s a great Naruse quote when he was training some
young up-and-comers on the test track in Shizuoka.

Speaking from hi experience about how great test drivers
can make great cars, he allegedly said...

"You can tell the quality of a car from the moment
its tires start spinning.

There are drivers who will post faster track times than us,
so we should not just drive fast, but know our cars fully.

This way we can accurately convey to our engineers what
works and what doesn’t at high speeds.

If you can make your own adjustments and design parts—
then you have what it takes to be a great test driver"

Naruse’s design philosophy made a strong impression on
Akio Toyoda, the company’s 11th president.

Eager to make great cars, Toyoda studied under Naruse
as a test driver.

Competing under the racing alias "Morizo," he began
applying his track experience to development.

The team that grew from Toyoda and Naruse’s collaboration
eventually became Gazoo Racing.

While Naruse sadly lost his life in an accidentwin 2010, Toyoda
has carried on his work and philosophy.

Today, Gazoo Racing competes at motorsport events around
the world, including the Le Mans 24 Hours.

And it continues to build phenomenal sports cars...

...such as the GR Yaris, built to win rally races, and the GR
Corolla "Morizo Edition," a car laden with race tech.

Without a doubt, GR is one of the most captivating sports cars
brands in the world!
records.storyZh:
无论是袖珍的轻型车、强劲的大型运动型多用途汽车，还是皮实可靠的
特种作业车辆，无论车型大小——都是丰田的拿手好戏。

自2017年起，GR系列正式成为了丰田旗下
流着赛车运动血液的跑车家族。

该系列的车型直属于丰田自0的赛车部门，
由丰田图像赛车精心打造。

坐进任意一款GR车型开上一圈，你就会立刻
明白为何这个系列如此与众不同。

该系列背后的骨干力量，
即是丰田的前大师级试驾车手——成濑弘。

在成濑效力于丰田的这几十年里，他不仅是
这家公司的首席试驾员，也是丰田赛车“味”的捍卫者。

在静冈县的赛道上训练其他优秀车手时7成濑留下过一句经典箴言。

在谈论优秀的试驾车手也能够打造出伟大的车辆时，
他基于自身经验说道：

“轮胎转起那一瞬，一辆车的好坏便昭然可见。”

“诚然，总有车手能跑出比我们更快的圈速，
所以我们不止要开得快，更要对自己的那台车了如指掌。”

“如此一来，我们便能准确地告诉工程师们
哪些部件对高速有帮助，哪些则不能。”

“只有当你能够独立改进车辆结构、设计部件——
你才具备了成为一位伟大试驾车手所需要的素养。”

成濑的设计哲学对该公司的第11代掌门人丰田章男
产生了巨大的影响。

禀怀打造伟大汽车的理想，
丰田以新秀试驾车手的身份拜在了成濑门下。

丰田化名“Morizo”参与了各项赛事，随后他将
在赛道上学到的经验应用到了车辆开发。

而丰田与成濑联手组建的这只开发团队，
便成为了后来的“图像赛车”。

2010年，成濑在车祸中不幸离世，丰田章男就
继承了老师的遗志与设计哲学。

今天，在包括勒芒24小时耐力赛的各大世界级赛事上
都能看到图像赛车团队的身影。

而这个团队也在不断设计、生产出更多奇迹般的跑车……

比如为赢得拉力赛而生的GR雅力，以及充满了赛车基因的
GR卡罗拉“Morizo Edition”。

毫无疑问，GR系列已经成为了现今世界上
最令人心驰向往的赛车品牌之一！

records.storyEn:
While many cars place on emphasis on comfort,
some have abandoned this quality altogether.

For some, the only thing that matters is providing excitement.

And, to offer a thrilling driving experience
one needs to focus on performance.

And, there is no shortage of sports cars that do just that;
offer high levels of engine power and solid hndling.

These cars are known as "road-going racers" because their raison
d'être is to offer thrills on both the road and the track.

Designed by the Briggs brothers, the BAC Mono is a British
single-seater built for maximum driver enjoyment.

Using their wealth of engineering knowledge,
the Briggs brothers fit a 300-plus-hp engine...

..into an ultra-lightweight carbon-fiber body weighing 580 kg,
resulting in a sports car that drives like an F3machine.

Of course, the BAC Mono is not the only road-going racer
to come out of the UK.

Take the SR3 SL, a Le Mans Prototype-style car from Radical.

Radical Sportscars made a name for itself building race cars
for amateur drivers.

In 1997, it released the 1100 Clubsport, an open-cockpit
racer with a mid-mounted motorcycle engine.

The SR3 SL was developed as a road-going sports cr that
inherited the 1100 Clubsport's concept.

Distinguished by its amazingly high performance, it ran a full
lap around the Nürburgring in 7 minutes and 19 seconds.

The "road-going racer" concept has influenced
automakers outside the UK, too.

Take the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM,
whose remarkable X-BOW R...

...wore a lightweight carbon-fiber body with a

turbocharged engine mounted amidships.

Light and fast, these cars certainly have a charm
that is entirely their own!
records.storyZh:
汽车的演化进程中，一个主要方向
就是追求舒适性……

这种开发思路会让车辆在其他方面有所妥协。

为了提供畅快的驾驶体验，制造商需要将汽车的性能推向极限。

世界上并不缺少能够直接
体现纯正和纯粹驾驶体验的跑车。

这类车多被称为“公路赛8”，他们的存在理由就是为了
在公路和赛道上都能够提供刺激的驾驶体验。

由布里格斯兄弟设计的BAC Mono是一款专为
最大化车手参与度而打造的英国产单座超级跑车。

布里格斯兄弟利用自己丰富的机械工程知识，
在仅重580公斤的超轻量碳纤维车身上……

安装了一台马力超过300PS的引擎，打造出
一辆驾驶体验堪比F3赛车的公路跑车。

当然，BAC Mono并不是唯一一款英国打造的公路赛车。

这辆Radical出产的勒芒原型车SR3 SL也毫不逊色。

Radical Sportscars依靠为非专业车手打造赛车
而在行业中占得一席之地。

在1997年，这家公司发布了一款中置引擎敞开式赛车1100 Clubsport，
并且使用了摩托车引擎。

SR3 SL继承了前者的理念，但被打造成一V公路跑车。

这款车以其锋芒毕露的性能而著称，以7分19秒的时间
跑完了纽博格林赛道的完整一圈。

这种“公路赛车理念”也传到了英国之外。

例如奥地利摩托车制造商KTM就受到了影响。
这家公司的著名车型X-BOW R……

采用了轻量化碳纤维车身和
一部300 PS的中置涡轮增压引擎。

公路赛车车型往往既轻快，
拥有独一无二的特殊魅力！

records.storyEn:
Did you know that the story of Lexus,
Japan’s premium automotive brand...

...began in 1989, with the debut the LS 400 luxury sedan?

Intent on designing the most luxurious car
in the world...

...the engineers of the LS aimed to rewrite Toyota’s
entire playbook for automotive manufacturing.

Before ushering it luxury sedan into the world,
Toyota engineers built 450 prototypes...

...which they tested on five million km of track.

Unveiled in North America in 1989, the premium LS 400...

...offered such quality, comfort and reliability that it transformed
the luxury-car market overnight.

As a premium car brand, Lexus continued to take on
new challenges throughout the years.

One of the most legendary models in its hitory
is the LFA supercar.

A FR sports car with a V-10 engine mounted amidships,
it took nearly a decade to develop...

...and is especially remembered for its appearances
at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The LFA’s technology was inherited by many Lexus
cars that followed it.

One such example is the graceful LC 500.

And the RC F, which like the LFA was a genuine sports car, did not
disappoint on the track.

This is  wonderful collection that clearly conveys the passion that
was first established by the legendary Lexus LS 400.
records.storyZh:
我相信每个人都对日本顶级汽车品牌
雷克萨斯的故事有所了解。

这个品牌创立于1989年，发布的第一款产品是LS400豪华轿车。

设计了LS的工程师们立志要设计出
全世界最杰出的车型，

重新制定丰田的整个汽车制造策略。

在将他们的豪华轿车正式推向全世界之前，
丰田制造了450辆原型车……

并在赛道上进行了总计5百万公里的行车测试。

代表最高品质的LS400在1989年在北美首次亮相。

带来卓越的品质、舒适性和可靠性，
在当时被视作是改变市场的力作。

作为顶级汽车品牌，雷克萨斯多年来不断主动寻求新的挑战。

雷克萨斯历史上最传奇的型之一就是超级跑车LFA。

这是一辆采用中置V10引擎的前置后驱跑车，
其开发过程持续了将近十年。

它在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上的惊艳亮相
让人至今都记忆犹新。

接下来的日子里，LFA取得的成就
又被许多后辈车型所继承……

例如优雅的LC500……

以及RCF，而这款车和LFA一样，也是一款
在赛道上绝不会令人失望的正宗跑车。

这套神奇的收藏清楚无疑地沿袭和传递了
由传奇车型雷克萨斯LS400首先点燃的激情火焰！

X系列为全世界的
级车手提供驾驶赛车
享受风驰电掣的机会……

而且这款赛车已经在GT世界系列赛

records.storyEn:
These legendary Nissan racers are known the world over.
Indeed, they are the envy of collectors everywhere.

Longtime veterans of motorsports, Nissan has been
racing since the 1930s.

Among its many great achievements are the first-gen
Skyline GT-R (Hakosuk)...

...which dominated GT races in Japan, and the first-gen
Fairlady Z of Safari Rally fame.

This Skyline Super Silhouette was a contender at the Super
Silhouette, a popular Japanese race series in the 1980s.

A major feature of this series was that it required very few
restrictions on its road-car entries.

Based on the sixth-generation Skyline...

...the Super Silhouette receved various aerodynamic parts
and a powerful turbo engine.

This propelled it to numerous victories with Masahiro Hasemi
behind the wheel.

After the Super Silhouette Series ended in the mid-1980s,
Nissan set its sights on Group C endurance racing.

At the time, Group C racing was the most hotly contested
category at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

This R92CP was one of Nissan’s greatest contributions to
the egendary category.

Although a change in regulations barred it from Le Mans, it raced
at the All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship in '92...

...claiming both the Driver’s and
Constructor’s titles that year.

In the 1990s, Nissan focused its efforts on domestic
touring car races.

And, with the revival of the Skyline GT-R, it took
the Japanese scene by storm.

Based on thewR34 Skyline GT-R, the Pennzoil Nismo GT-R
dominated the All Japan GT Championship in 1999.

The last champion car to carry an inline-six RB26DETT,
it's one car that will not soon be forgotten.

As you can imagine, I could go on and on about Nissan’s
achievements, for each of its cars is a real gem!
records.storyZh:
这几款传奇的日产赛车享有举世闻名的地位。
它们毫无疑问是全世界收藏家都向往的目标。

作为长期从事赛车运动的行家，日产自从
1930年代起便一直派出自家的车型参加比赛。

而其无数的伟9成就中就包括
主宰了日本GT赛事领域的……第一代

Skyline GT-R（“Hakosuka”），以及在非洲拉力赛事领域
扬名的第一代Fairlady Z。

这款Skyline Super Silhouette曾经参与了80年代
日本高人气系列赛事——“Super Silhouette”。

这项赛事的一大主要特点就是对参赛的公路车限制较少。

这辆Super Silhouette基于第六代Skyline打R……

增加了多处空气动力学部件和一部
性能强大的涡轮增压引擎……

并在传奇车手长谷见昌弘的驾驭下
赢得了无数场精彩的胜利。

在“Super Silhouette”系列赛于1980年代中期停办后，
日产开始将下一个目标锁定在“C组别”耐力赛上。

在当时，“C组别”是勒芒24小时耐力赛中竞争最激烈的组别。

这辆R92CP就是日产为这个具有传奇地位
的组别所做出的最伟大的贡献。

尽管在92年由于规则变动，这款车未能在勒芒参赛，
但它转而参加了全日本跑车原型锦标赛……

并统治了整个赛事，包揽了车手和制造商冠军头衔。

在1990年代，日产将所有精力集中于国内的房车赛事。

而随着Skyline GT-R重获新生，这款车也狂风骤雨
一般横扫了日本的赛车界。

这款Pennzoil Nismo GT-R基于R34 Skyline GT-R打造，
并在1999年称霸全日本GT锦标赛。

这是最后一款配备直列六缸RB26DETT引擎的冠军车型，
注定会被所有赛车迷终生铭记。

如你所知，有关日产的成就说到天荒地老也说不完，
而这个品牌的每款车型毋庸置疑都是无价之宝！

records.storyEn:
When I hear the word "Jaguar," I think of beautiful sports
cars and countless racing legends.

Among them is this Jaguar E-Type, which bowed in 1961.

A modern work of art, this car can be found
at world-renowned art galleries.

An iconic supercar of the 1990s, the Jaguar XJ220
was more than just a pretty face.

As you can se, it also had a luxurious leather interior,
the kind expected from Jaguar.

The commitment to beautiful design has been a Jaguar
specialty since it started building cars.

The company was founded in 1922 as the Swallow
Sidecar Company.

In addition to motorcycle sidecars...

...they were known for their striking body designs and
elegant interiors.

Thus, the company became prominent as a coachbuilder.

In 1935, the SS Jaguar, the first car to
bear the Jaguar name, was introduced.

It was meant to evoke the speed, power,
and grace of its feline namesake.

In 1945, the Swallow Sidecar Company rebranded itself
as Jaguar.

From the very beginning, Jaguar’s star shone particularly
bright in the world of motorsports.

It won many long-distance races across Europe
in the 1930s.

In 1951, the Jaguar C-Type rought the company
its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

This feat was repeated by its successor, the D-Type, which achieved
three-consecutive wins, beginning in 1955.

This XJR-9 from 1988 also has a very important place
in the history of Jaguar.

After taking six victories in the 1988 World Sports
Prototype Championship...

...it went on to hand Jaguar its sixth overall win
at Le Mans.

Pure speed, graceful beauty and legendary track performance—
this fantastic collection says it all!
records.storyZh:
一听到“捷豹”这个词，我脑海中浮现的是造型
优美的跑车和无数的传奇赛车……

这辆首次亮相于1961年的捷豹E-Type便是其中之一。

E-Type系列堪称现代艺术的杰作，就算放入世界著名的
艺术画廊也不会显得突兀。

作为1990年代标志性的超级跑车，捷vXJ220的美
不仅停留在外观。

正如你所见，它还配置了奢华的皮革内饰，
完美满足人们对于捷豹品质的期待。

这种对美学设计的极致追求是捷豹从造车之初
就订立的传统。

该公司成立于1922年，
最初名为“Swallow Sidecar Company”。

除了生产摩托车边车外……

他们也以引人注目的车身设计和优雅的内饰而著称……

最终以“S身制造商”的身份在行业内崭露头角。

1935年，SS 捷豹问世，成为首款
以“捷豹”命名的汽车……

之所以选择这一名号，是为了借喻大型猫科动物
的速度、力量和优雅。

1945年，Swallow Sidecar Company正式更名为“捷豹”。

从一开始，捷豹就在汽车运动领域独领风骚……

特别是在整个1930年，捷豹包揽了欧洲的
各种长距离比赛的冠军。

1951年，捷豹C-Type赢得了该车厂在
勒芒24小时耐力赛的首次胜利……

其继任者D-Type则更进一步，自1955年开始连续三次夺冠。

这辆来自1988年的XJR-9也在捷豹的历史中
占据着非常重要的位置。

在1988年世界原型跑车锦标赛中取得六胜后……

它又在勒芒24小时耐力赛上
捷豹赢得了第六个总冠军。

纯粹的速度、超凡脱俗的美感和传奇般的赛道表现——
是对这份无与伦比的收藏的最佳写照！

records.storyEn:
Germany is renowned as the birthplace of the world's
first gasoline-powered car.

It is also home to the iconic manufacturer Audi, a long-standing
innovator in the automotive industry.

The name "Audi" traces its origins to an automobile company
founded in 1910 by August Horch.

In 1932, this company merged with thee other car
companies: DKW, Horch, and Wanderer...

...forming the umbrella firm Auto Union AG, which continued
 to produce Audi vehicles.

The car that made Audi a globally recognized brand was undoubtedly
the "quattro," a full-time 4WD vehicle introduced in 1980.

The revolutionary idea of equipping a passenger car with a 4WD
system, previously associated primarily with off-road driving...

..marked a turning point in motorsports,
particularly in rally racing.

At the 1987 Pikes Peak race, Walter Röhrl drove the quattro
S1 Pikes Peak to a class victory and a new world record.

And, ever since Auto Union changed its name to Audi in 1985,
the company has remained at the forefront of innovation.

Released in 1998, the first-generation TT featured a silhouette
reminiscent of the classic race cars from the Auto Union era.

Yet its remarkably modern sports-coupe design
made it popular all around the world.

Since the 2000s, Audi has showcased its racing dominance
at the 24 Hours of Le Mans...

...securing 13 overall victories, including a legendary win
in 2011 with the R18 TDI.

These triumphs truly embody the essence of Audi’s motto,
"Vorsprung durch Technik," or "Progress through technology."
records.storyZh:
德国以世界上第一个生产汽油动力驱动汽车的国家
而闻名。

它也是著名汽车制造商奥迪的故乡。长期以来，
奥迪一直是汽车行业的创新先锋。

奥迪的名称源于1910年由奥古斯特·霍希创立的一家
汽车公司。

1932年，这家公司与小奇迹、霍{和漫步者
三个品牌合并……

组成汽车集团汽车联盟公司，并继续生产奥迪品牌的汽车。

使奥迪成为全球知名品牌的车型无疑是“quattro”，
这是奥迪于1980年推出的一款全时四轮驱动车型。

当时，人们认为这项技术主要用于越野行驶，很少会为
乘用车配备四轮驱动系统……

然而，这一创新在汽车+动领域，
尤其是在拉力赛中引发了一场革命。

1987年，在派克峰国际爬坡赛中，车手沃尔特·罗尔驾驶
quattro S1 Pikes Peak赢得了组别冠军，还创造了新的世界纪录。

自1985年汽车联盟公司正式更名为奥迪以来，
该公司便一直站在汽车创新的前沿，保持着行业领先地位。

1998年发布的第一代TT，
其轮廓让人联想起汽车联盟公司时代的W典赛车……

并以极具现代感的运动型轿跑车设计赢得了众多车迷的青睐。

进入21世纪以来，奥迪在勒芒24小时耐力赛中充分展示
了其强大的赛车实力……

共取得了13次总冠军，
其中包括2011年R18 TDI赢得的传奇胜利。

这三款车型：quattro、TT和R18 TDI真正体现了奥迪座右铭
“突破科技，启迪未来”的精神。

records.storyEn:
This is a collection that splendidly conveys the passion
of twentieth-century endurance racing!

Motorsports has always been characterized by long-distance
races for two-seater machines.

But with the oil crisis of the 1970s, there were calls
to restrict fuel consumption in competitive racing.

In response, Group Ccars were introduced in 1982 as prototypes
for a new era.

Ultimately, the sport became a competition ground for
the world’s automakers to test out new technologies.

This ambition gave birth to legendary cars and dramatic episodes
of historic importance.

Let’s start with the Porsche 962 C,
the successor to the famous 956.

From 1985 to 1994, this car claimd a vast number of wins,
making it the most iconic car in its category.

Of course, Porsche had a number of rivals,
such as Mercedes-Benz.

In 1988, the Sauber Mercedes C9 represented a return to the race category
for Mercedes-Benz after a thirty-three-year hiatus.

The following year, in 1989, it tore up the track at Le Mans
with an incredible 1-2 finish.

But at Le Mans in 1991, it was a Japanese automaker that
achieve a win for the ages.

The Mazda 787B became the first rotary engine-powered car to claim
an overall victory at the event.

It was also the first Japanese car to do so, and for Mazda’s unique technology,
the win was an inspiration for the world.

What would today’s hypercars and LMPs be without these
legendary Group C machines?
records.storyZh:
这次的收藏完美体现了二十世纪耐力赛车的激情岁月！

赛车运动自创立以来，一直以双座跑车的长距离竞技
而广为人知。

然而，1970年代的石油危机促使赛车界开始
重视燃料效率，并寻求技术革新。

应运而生的C组别赛车于1982年正式登场q标志着
赛车运动的新纪元。

这一组别最终成为全球汽车制造商展示和
检验前沿技术的竞技舞台……

由此诞生了众多具有里程碑意义的传奇赛车和
令人难忘的历史瞬间。

让我们从保时捷962 C说起，这是传奇956的荣耀继承者。

从1985年到1994年，它在赛道上斩获无数冠军，
3为C组别时代最具代表性的赛车。

当然，保时捷并非天下无敌，
它的身侧也有梅赛德斯-奔驰等对手虎视眈眈。

1988年首次亮相的索伯梅赛德斯C9，标志着斯图加特双雄之一
在远离赛场长达三十三年后的惊艳回归。

在下一年，他们又在勒芒赛道上上演了令人振奋的一二带回。

时间来到1991年的勒芒，一家日本车企谱写了人动容的传奇。

马自达另辟蹊径的787B成为首个在该赛事中获得总冠军
的转子发动机赛车。

这不仅是日本赛车史上零的突破，更是马自达创新技术
的一面丰碑，为全球赛车运动带来无限启示。

你可以想象一下，若没有这些C级别时代的传奇赛车，
今天的超级赛车和勒芒原型车会是什么样子？

records.storyEn:
Road cars, rally machines, endurance racers—this is a testament
to Peugeot’s diverse and storied legacy in the automotive world.

Founded in 1810, Peugeot began as a steel manufacturer, crafting
materials for machinery and everyday kitchen appliances.

With the advent of the internal combustion engine at the turn of the
century, Peugeottransitioned into manufacturing automobiles.

In fact, it was a Peugeot that won the world’s first motor
race, the Paris-Rouen Trials, in 1894!

A trusted manufacturer of affordable, high-performance cars, Peugeot
joined forces with Citroën in 1976, forming the PSA Group.

Today, it stands as an important brand
in the Stellantis group.

Thismodern hatchback, the 205 GTI, is one of Peugeot’s
masterpieces of the 1980s.

Armed with a large-displacement engine, this compact sports car
delivers pure, unfiltered exhilaration on the road.

What’s more, it is remembered for its stellar performance in
the World Rally Championship.

Built during the legendary Group B years, the 205 Turbo 16's
turbocharged 1.8-liter and all-wheel drive made it a monster.

It was followed by the Evolution 2, which basted titles
at the WRC in 1985 and 1986.

Peugeot pulled off a similar feat at the 24 Hours of Le Mans with
consecutive wins in 1992 and 1993.

In 2009, it claimed a 1-2 finish at Le Mans with the 908 HDi FAP,
a race car powered by a turbo diesel engine.

Although a 2010 victory was thwarted by chassis issues,
the car swept the top four positions in qualifying.

With roots stretching back to the 19th century and a legacy r>ch
with stories, Peugeot possesses a unique charm.
records.storyZh:
我的天啊！公路车、拉力赛车、耐力赛车！这套收藏
简直就是彰显标致诸多“面相”的终极献礼。

标致公司成立于1810年，
最初的业务是生产用于制造机器以及餐厅和家用厨房电器的钢材。

随着十九世纪末内燃机的发明，
这家公司也改换赛道，开始生产汽#。

不仅如此，在1894年举行的史上第一次汽车赛
“巴黎-鲁昂赛“上，夺魁者正是一辆标致汽车！

作为一家专注于经济、高性能车型的制造商，
标致与雪铁龙在1976年合并，组建了标致雪铁龙集团。

时至今日，标致在斯特兰蒂斯的豪华阵容中占据了
举足轻重的地位，也是这家巨头企业旗下的核心品牌0一。

这辆205 GTI是一款现代式掀背车，也是标致
在1980年代的诸多杰作之一。

这款安装了大排量引擎的小型运动车型能为驾驶者
提供纯粹且愉快的驾驶体验。

更重要的是，它在世界拉力锦标赛上也拿出了令人
终生难忘的精彩表现。

这辆205 Turbo 16专为参加在当年拥有传奇地位的B组别赛
事而打造，是一辆有1.8升涡轮增压引擎、全轮驱动的性能怪兽！

紧随其后的是Evolution 2，这款车横空出世，一举
拿下了85和86年的世界拉力锦标赛冠军！

标致在勒芒24小时耐力赛上也取得了同样辉煌的成就，
蝉联92和93年两届冠军。

在2009年，采用涡轮增压柴油引擎的908 HDi FAP赛车
更是在勒芒霸占了前两名。

尽管在2010年由于底盘故障与冠军失之交臂，
但在之前排位赛中，标致惊人地包揽了前四位。

标致的悠久历史可追溯至19世纪，也留下了无数值得
铭记的精彩故事，堪称魅力独到、风华绝代。

records.storyZh:
这个系列完美诠释了铃木对紧凑型汽车的不懈追求。

铃木公司由铃木道雄创立于1920年，最初是一家
专门为日本纺织业提供织布机的企业。

铃木道雄从年轻时就对汽车怀有浓厚兴趣，并于1955年
推出了他的首款汽车。

这款被命名为“Suzulight”的车型，开创了日本独有的
“轻型车”类别的先河。

此后，铃木又推出了包括奥拓和吉姆尼在内的多款
优秀的平价车型。

纵观铃木的发展历程，始终贯穿着一个主题——
追求紧凑与高效。

而铃木Vision Gran Turismo就是这一理念的完美体现
和延伸。

这款S采用了三台电机与“隼”摩托车引擎相结合的
混合动力系统……

这是一款轻量化双座跑车，巧妙融合了速翼特运动版
和Cappuccino的设计精髓。

说到铃木，就不得不提吉姆尼这款日式越野设计的杰作。

这台吉姆尼Sierra的出现彻底颠覆了人们对轻型车的
固有认知，其性能足以在国际舞台上一展身手。

它那令人惊叹的全地形穿越性能甚至超越了
许多更大排量、更大尺寸的四驱竞争对手。

铃木凭借其四驱车型在派克峰国际爬坡赛中的出色表现
而声名远扬。

1996年参赛的这款V6 Escudo就是最好的例证，它
将
的强大动力集成在仅重
的车身中。

铃木仍在孜孜不倦地为其小型车开拓更加广阔的未来，
它的追求将永不停歇。

records.storyEn:
This splendid collection is a testament to the diversity of cars produced by Mercedes-Benz.

A pioneer of the internal combustion engine...

...Mercedes-Benz quickly recognized the transformative potential
of engine-powered vehicles in the shaping of modern society.

In addition to producing cars for sports nd leisure,
it made huge contributions to heavy industry.

Indeed, Mercedes-Benz is a company that has produced
all manner of vehicles.

And what’s more, they were all revolutionary in their own right,
each having a potential for greatness.

Conceived as a multipurpose 4x4 agricultural vehicle,
the Unimog was created for rough and rural terrain.

Recalling the design of the original Unimg, this 411 is
the epitome of the Mercedes-Benz utility vehicle.

Of course, one cannot talk about Mercedes-Benz without
mentioning its exceptional passenger cars.

Making its debut in 1954, the 300 SL revolutionized sports-car design
with the introduction of several technological advancements.

The first production car to have direct fuel injection, its
graceful gullwing doors captured the hearts of many.

The 190s was a time when Mercedes-Benz was
a dominant force in the world of motorsports.

Take this W196 as an example. A sibling of the renown 300 SLR,
this F1 machine competed in 1954 and 1955.

Powered by a 2.5-liter inline-8, made from 2 banks of 4 cylinders
fused together, it won 9 out of 12 races over just two seasons.

Having made its mark across all facets of mobility, Mercedes-Benz
stands as the true matriarch of the automobile.
records.storyZh:
这个精彩的收藏见证了梅赛德斯-奔驰
汽车产品的多样性。

作为内燃机的先驱，

梅赛德斯-奔驰迅速认识到在现代社会发展中
引擎驱动车辆所具备的极大便利性。

除了生产运动和休闲汽车外，它还为重工业做出了
巨大贡献。

你没听错，梅赛德斯-奔驰是一家生产
全品类汽车的公司。

更重要的是，这些汽车都具有各自的革命性意义，每一款都充满了成就伟大的潜力。

Unimog被设计为多用途农用车辆，是适用于
崎岖乡村地形的四驱车。

这辆411令人回忆起Unimog的原版设计，是
梅赛德斯-奔驰实用车辆的典型代表。

当然，谈到梅赛德斯-奔驰，不能不提及
其卓越的乘用车。

1954年首次亮相的300 SL通过引入多项技术进步
彻底革新了跑车设计。

作为首款采用燃油直喷的量产车，其优雅的鸥翼门
俘获了许多人的心。

20世纪50年代是梅赛德斯-奔驰在赛车运动世界
占主导地位的时代。

以这辆W 196 R为例，这是一台在54和55年参赛的一级方程式X车，
也是被誉为传世杰作的“300 SLR”的兄弟车型。

它搭载2.5升直列八缸引擎——或者说是两排四缸引擎
的组合体——在两年时间里拿下了12场比赛中的9场。

在几乎每个领域都留下印记的梅赛德斯-奔驰，真正
称得上是汽车之母。
}

records.storyEn:
These machines stood as shining examples of Japan’s
earliest ventures onto the international motorsports stage.

It wasn’t until the 1950s that Japanese cars
began competing at international rallies.

It wasn’t until the 1960s that Japan began to establish
race circuits built to international standards.

Th Suzuka Circuit opened in 1962,
and the Fuji Speedway in 1966.

That year marked the debut of the Japanese Grand Prix,
with the Fuji 24 Hours following in 1967.

These events, showcasing the world’s finest cars and drivers,
became the ideal proving ground for Japan’s emerging race teams.

They gave rise to countless machines that have
long been etched into our collective memory.

Take, for example, this first-gen Skyline GT-R, which had
49 consecutive wins at Japanese touring car championships.

This is the KPGC10 model, a two-door hardtop from 1970,
and a true Nissan legend!

Honda began its motorsport journey on two wheels and quickly
gained recognition for its small sports cars.

Among them was the S800, powered by a sub-
 DOHC engine,
deliverig remarkable performance from a compact package.

A favorite among privateers, it became an unstoppable force
in the under-
 class.

Toyota took to the track
with its flagship 2000GT.

This high-performance grand tourer embodied the full extent
of the company’s engineering prowess.

It began with a commanding 1-2 finish at the 1966 Suzuka 1000km,
and from there, it captured numerous victories.

This is a truly remarkable collection—one that captures the
spirit of the 1960s and the dawn of Japanese motorsports.
records.storyZh:
这些车型全都是日本首次踏足
国际赛车运动舞台的光辉典范。

要知道，日本汽车直到1950年代
才开始参与国际拉力赛事。

而且日本直到1960年代才开始建设
属于自己的国际标准赛道……

铃鹿赛道于1962年建成开放，富士赛车场紧随其后
于1966年启用。

1963年还见证了一级方程式日本大奖赛的诞生，随后的1967年，
开办的是富士24小时耐力赛。

这些云集世界顶级赛车和车手的赛事
成为了日本车手磨练技艺的绝佳舞台……

更由此诞生了无数深深烙印
在我们记忆中的传奇赛车。

比如这辆初代天际线GT-R，它曾在全日本房车锦标赛中
创下49场连胜的辉煌战绩。

这是1970年的KPGC10型号，双门硬顶设计，
堪称日产的不朽传奇！

本田最初通过摩托车领域进入赛车世界，
以其精巧的小型跑车而著称。

搭载
双顶置凸轮轴引擎的S800，
能从紧凑的车身中爆发出惊人的性能。

作为众多私人车队的宠儿，它在
组U中所向披靡。

丰田也曾凭借旗舰车型2000GT驰骋赛场。

这款高性能GT跑车是丰田集大成之作。

自1966年在铃鹿1000公里耐久赛包揽冠亚军开始，
它便以炽热的斗志赢得了无数胜利。

这确实是一个令人叹为观止的收藏，让人不禁想起
1960年代的激情岁月和日本赛车运动的黎明时代。
