records.storyEn:
I see that you had assembled a divine lineup of Alfa Romeos
that would have impressed car collectors all over the world.

The brand’s history dates back to 1910, to the founding of the
Anonima Lombarda Fabbrica Automobili in Milan.

Known then by the acronym ALFA, the company set about
making a name for itslf in racing straight out of the gate.

When entrepreneur Nicola Romeo assumed management in 1918,
Alfa Romeo was born.

Romeo believed that fueling the company’s insatiable hunger
for racing would ultimately serve both business and R&D.

And he was right. A beacon of innovation, Alfa Romeo united
some of the finest engineers and drivers of its era.

One of the company’s masterpieces from the 1930s was the
8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta.

Powered by a supercharged inline-8, the 8C 2900B carried an
elegant Touring body that left onlookers sighing with awe.

After the Second World War, in the 1960s, Alfa Romeo scored
a major success with its Giulia series.

Th Zagato blended steel tubing with a lithe, sporty body.
Light and fast, it was a fierce competitor on the track.

Time passed, but Alfa Romeo’s fighting spirit never waned,
continuing to shine brilliantly in touring car racing.

The 155 2.5 V6 TI stood as a prime example of that success,
striking fear into rivals at DTM races throughout the 1990s.

]Its combination of 4WD, outstanding performance, and luxury
made it one of the defining cars of its generation.

Even today, Alfa Romeo’s racing blood runs thick—its cars
exciting fans across the globe for years to come.
records.storyZh:
看到你集结了如此惊艳的阿尔法·罗密欧阵容，
足以让全球汽车收藏家为之倾倒。

该品牌的历史可追溯至1910年，
伦巴第汽车制造厂在米兰创立。

该公司最初以缩写“A.L.F.A”闻名，甫一成立
便在赛车领域崭露头角。

1918年企业家尼古拉·罗密欧接管经营后，
“阿尔法·罗密欧”传奇正式启航。

罗密欧坚信，将赛车竞速作为公司的战略重心，
其带来的尖端技术突破必将反哺商业成功。

事实印证了他的远见。作为创新标杆，阿尔法·罗密欧汇聚了
当时最杰出的工程师与赛车手。

该品牌在1930年代的巅峰之作当属这款
8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta。

搭载机械增压直列八缸引擎，8C 2900B的
优雅旅行车车身令观者惊叹不已。

二战后至1960年代，阿尔法·罗密欧
凭借Giulia系列再创辉煌。

Zagato融合钢管车架与运动化车身，
以轻量化设计与疾速现成为赛道劲旅。

岁月流转，阿尔法·罗密欧的竞速之魂不灭，
在房车赛中持续绽放光彩。

155 2.5 V6 TI即是其成功典范，
在整个90年代德国房车大师赛赛事中令对手闻风丧胆。

四驱系统、卓越性能与
奢华品质的完美融合，铸就时代标杆。

直至今日，阿尔法·罗密欧仍流淌着浓烈的赛车血液，
其车型必将继续引爆全球车迷的激情。

records.requirementsEn: Collect: Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder '54, Porsche Spyder type 550/1500RS '55, Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
records.requirementsZh: 收集：Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder '54、Porsche Spyder type 550/1500RS '55、Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
records.storyEn:
I see that you had assembled an all-star cast
of fine and elegant open-road race cars.

The original purpose of racing had been to see how far
a car could be driven without breaking down.

Held on public roads, it later evolved into the long-distance
trials that spread across Europe and the Americas.

The cars that competed in them were part road car
and part race car.

This hybrid identity gave the machines of the 1950s and 1960s
a character all their own.

It was largely because of this history that so many masterpieces
were born in that era.

Debuting at the Mille Miglia in 1953, the Maserati A6GCS/53
was a prime example of what I mean by “masterpiece.”

With its liht yet powerful Fantuzzi body, this car set
the standard for sports-car design.

Another formidable contender of the time was the Spyder Type 550,
Porsche’s first mid-engine sports car.

The 1500 RS, a racing version of the 550, carried a lightweight
aluminum body and a DOHC engine, wielded like a weapon.

So fierce was this car that, in 1955, it claimed
class victories at both the Mille Miglia and Le Mans.

In the 1960s, circuits replaced roads as the main venues for
competition, giving rise to thoroughbred racing machines.

The Giulia TZ2 carrozzata da Zagato from Alfa Romeo
was one such jewel of this transitional period.

Although derived from the TZ road car, the Zagato was built
for racing, making it the last of Alfa’s road-going racers.

As you can see, the storied tradition of open-road racing $erved
as the cradle for many an automotive masterpiece.
,
records.storyZh:
看到你已集结了一支全明星阵容的
精致优雅公路赛车。

早期赛车运动的初衷，是为了验证
车辆在故障前能够行驶的极限距离。

这些在公共道路上举办的赛事，后来逐渐演变为
如今风靡于欧美地区的长距离耐力赛。

参赛v型兼具公路车的实用风格
与赛车的竞技血统。

这种双重身份为1950至1960年代的汽车
赋予了独特个性。

这个时代之所以能诞生众多的杰作，
很大程度上要归功于这段历史渊源。

1953年亮相于传奇的意大利一千英里耐力赛，这款
玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53正是我所说的“杰作”典范。

其轻量化且动力湃的范特仕车身，
为跑车设计树立了全新标杆。

与其同时代的强劲对手还有Spyder Type 550，
这是保时捷首款中置引擎跑车。

作为550的赛道版本，1500 RS配备轻量化
铝制车身与双顶置凸轮轴引擎，化身赛道利器。

这款车性能强悍，以致在1955年同时斩获
意大利一千英里耐力赛与勒芒24小时赛的组别桂冠。

160年代，专业赛道逐步取代公路成为主要赛场，
纯种赛车应运而生。

阿尔法·罗密欧Giulia TZ2 carrozzata da Zagato
正是这一转型期的绝美代表。

Zagato虽然基于TZ公路车打造，
但却是专为赛道而生，成为阿尔法·罗密欧最后一代合法上路赛车。

由此可见，悠久的公路赛车传统
孕育了众多汽车工业的传世杰作。

records.storyEn:
This is an indispensable collection for understanding
Mazda’s place in the world today.

Founded in 1920, the company began life as
Toyo Cork Kogyo, a cork-making factory.

In 1931, it changed its name to Toyo Kogyo and
started producing small three-wheeled trucks.

Toyo Kogyo entered the assenger car market in 1960, around the
same time it began developing its own rotary engine.

In 1967, it introduced the Cosmo Sport, whose legacy would
eventually lead to the 787B’s 24 Hours of Le Mans triumph.

Always in search of what set it apart from the competition,
Mazda succeeded in producing many unique cars.

The Mazda Miata was one such model, epitomizing Mazda’s
pursuit of individualiy.

Revitalizing the lightweight sports car market, its production
numbers earned it a Guinness World Record.

In the 21st century, Mazda broadened its horizons with
SKYACTIV technology and its Kodo design philosophy.

The CX-30, a compact SUV, exemplified this new era
and was widely celebrated for its elegant exterior.

Its revolutionary SKYACTIV-X compression ignition engine pushed
the boundaries of internal combustion technology.

Naturally, one could not speak of Mazda without recalling
its rotary-engine sports cars, such as the RX-7 and RX-8.

A harbinger of things to come, the RX-VISION was unveiled
at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015.

With its graceful long-nose/short-deck body, it was astounding—
a design destined to be coveted by collectors someday.

With electrification changing the way we think about cars, maybe
the time was ripe for Mazda to redefine them once again.
records.storyZh:
要理解马自达当今在汽车领域的世界地位，
这个收藏系列不可或缺。

该公司始建于1920年，最初名为东洋软木工业株式会社，
从事软木制造业务。

1931年更名为东洋工业株式会社，
开始生产小型三轮货车。

1960年东洋工&株式会社进军乘用车市场，
恰逢公司着手自主研发转子引擎。

1967年推出的科兹摩跑车奠定了技术基石，
其精神遗产最终通过在勒芒24小时耐力赛夺魁的787B得以传承。

马自达始终追求与竞品的差异化优势，
成功打造了众多独具特色的车型。

依诺斯Roadster便是彰显马自达
品牌个性追求的典范之作。

此车为轻量化跑车市场注入新生机，
其产量更荣获吉尼斯世界纪录认证。

进入21世纪，马自达凭借创驰蓝天技术
与魂动设计理念开拓了新境界。

CX-30作为新时代紧凑型运动型多用途汽车的代表，
其优雅外观设计广受赞誉。

革命性的创驰蓝天-X压燃引擎
正在为内燃机技术开辟全新道路。

当然，提及马自达必然绕不开
其转U引擎跑车，诸如RX-7与RX-8。

预示未来方向的RX-VISION概念车
于2015年东京车展首次亮相。

其优雅的长前鼻短后悬设计令人叹为观止，
有望成为收藏家未来的必藏珍品。

随着电气化浪潮重塑对汽车的认知，
或许现在正是马自达为我们重新定义汽车的最佳时机。

records.storyZh:
这个星辉闪耀的收藏充分体现了
现代在高性能汽车制造领域的执著追求。

自1967年创立以来，现代已经
成长为享誉全球的汽车制造商。

Here is a collection that captured the spirit of American

The 1950s marked a golden age for American cars, but the 1960s
ushered in a search for new performance-driven values.

Those values gave rise to a new breed of midsize coupes
fitted with oversized engines.

Unassuming at first glance, they delivered formidable performance
under the hood and quickly left rivals behind.

Dubbed “muscle cars,” they gained a strong following
among younger American drivers.

U.S. manufacturers responded, producing a wave

The Chevrolet Chevelle SS, often called the

...tood out on the drag strip with its available

of 0-60 mph in under 6 seconds.

Within General Motors, icons came not only from Chevrolet
but also from Pontiac.

The second-generation Pontiac GTO Judge featured

.

records.storyZh:
眼前的这套收藏捕捉到了
美国汽车设计的灵魂——雄壮、张扬以及自由奔放！

20世纪50年代是美国汽车的黄金岁月。
但进入20世纪60年代后，人们开始寻找新的价值取向。

这种思潮催生了一类中型双门轿跑，装载了超大排量的引擎。

一眼看去似乎平平无奇，
但引擎盖下暗藏的玄机，却足以令对手望尘莫及。

这类车被冠以“肌肉车”之名，
迅速在美国年轻人中风靡开来。

美国各大厂商看准这一新兴市场，全力投入，
由此诞生了许多跨时代的传奇车型。

这一款便是被誉为“终极中型车”的
雪佛兰Chevelle SS…

它搭载一台硕大的7.4升V8引擎，在直线加速赛中所向披靡。

而克莱斯勒也不甘人后，通过旗下的道奇品牌加入战局。

这款Charger R/T 426 Hemi堪称肌肉车中的杰作。

它搭载源自纳斯卡赛事的7升V8引擎，
在6秒内便可完成0-60英里/小时的加速！

在通用汽车家族中，不仅雪佛兰旗下名车辈出，
庞蒂亚克同样贡献了无数经U。

例如这款第二代的庞蒂亚克GTO Judge。

其升级的6.6升V8引擎能够爆发出
的强悍马力。
再加上亲民的售价，令其一经推出便轰动市场。

尽管70年代的石油危机为肌肉车的时代划上了句号，
但这些经典肌肉车的光芒，如今仍然耀眼夺目。

records.storyEn:
This collection tells the story of an era of prototype sports cars.

Energy efficiency has always been the key to success in
long-distance endurance racing.

And energy-recovery systems have been part of the
FIA World Endurance Championship since 2012.

This decision was welcomed by manufacturers focusedon
electrification, resulting in a wave of hybrid prototypes.

The technology advanced dramatically each year, and by 2015,
record lap times were being posted at several tracks.

The 2016 season then saw an intense three-way battle unfold
between Porsche, Audi and Toyota.

This 919 Hybrid, a prototype introduced by Porsche in 2014,
became known as the “endurance king.”

It has a compact turbocharged 2.0-liter V-4 engine that it used
to great effect in races including Le Mans.

But Porsche had a serious challenger in the form of a diesel hybrid
developed by Audi with the famous Joest team.

The R18 may have shared its name with its predecessors, but it was
a new model, with prominent fenders and an F1-style nose.

The 4.0-liter diesel turbo engine was paired with a new hybrid unit,
a setup that made it one of Audi’ most advanced prototypes.

Over in Japan, Toyota developed a new prototype of its own,
entering it into the championship in 2016.

The TS050 Hybrid, a 4WD car with motors on both the front and
rear wheels, was designed specifically with Le Mans in mind.

And sure enough, its battle with Porsche on that legendary track
was dramatic, instantly entering the annals of racing history.

These days, endurance racing iswcontested under new regulations and
these models can be seen as marking the end of the LMP1 era.
records.storyZh:
这个收藏承载了原型跑车时代的故事。

能源效率一直是长距离耐力赛成功的关键……

自2012年起，能量回收系统就被允许在
国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛中使用。

这一决定受到了致力于电气化的各大厂商的欢迎，
大量混合动力车因:出现在赛道上。

随着技术突飞猛进，2015年，多条赛道都刷新了圈速纪录。

2016赛季，保时捷、奥迪和丰田之间
爆发了一场激烈的三方争夺战。

这台保时捷在2014年推出的原型车919 Hybrid，
后来被誉为“耐力之王”。

它搭载了一台紧凑的2升V4涡轮增压引擎，
在包括勒芒在内的比赛中^挥了巨大作用。

但保时捷面临一个强大的挑战者，
来自奥迪与约斯特车队合作打造的柴油引擎。

R18虽与前辈同名，但实则是一款全新车型，
拥有突出的轮拱和一级方程式式高鼻锥。

其4升柴油涡轮增压引擎配备了一套新的混合动力单元，
这套配置助其两度夺冠。

在日本，丰田迅速研发出了自己的原型车，
	于2016年投入锦标赛。

这款TS050-Hybrid是一款前后轮均配备电机的四驱车，
将勒芒视作目标主战场。

果不其然，它与保时捷在传奇的勒芒赛道上
展开了极其激烈的较量，立时将自己的名字写入赛车史册。

如今，耐力赛的规则再次改写，我们可以将这三款车型
视为勒芒原型车1时代落幕的标志。
